+use std::cell::RefCell;
+use std::collections::HashMap;
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+pub enum UiFontKind {
+    Sans,
+    Serif,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiTextLayout {
+    pub width: f32,
+    pub line_height: f32,
+    pub glyph_offsets: Vec<f32>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiFontFamilies {
+    pub sans: String,
+    pub serif: String,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+struct LayoutKey {
+    font: UiFontKind,
+    text: String,
+    size_q4: u16,
+    bold: bool,
+    italic: bool,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+struct LayoutCache {
+    factory: windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: UiFontFamilies,
+    cache: HashMap<LayoutKey, UiTextLayout>,
+}
+
+pub struct UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    inner: RefCell<LayoutCache>,
+}
+
+impl UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    pub fn new(families: UiFontFamilies) -> windows::core::Result<Self> {
+        use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+            DWriteCreateFactory, DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED, IDWriteFactory,
+        };
+
+        let factory: IDWriteFactory = unsafe { DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED)? };
+        Ok(Self {
+            inner: RefCell::new(LayoutCache {
+                factory,
+                families,
+                cache: HashMap::new(),
+            }),
+        })
+    }
+
+    #[cfg(not(windows))]
+    pub fn new(_families: UiFontFamilies) -> Result<Self, ()> {
+        Ok(Self {})
+    }
+
+    pub fn layout(
+        &self,
+        font: UiFontKind,
+        text: &str,
+        font_size_px: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+        #[cfg(windows)]
+        {
+            let key = LayoutKey {
+                font,
+                text: text.to_string(),
+                size_q4: (font_size_px.max(0.0) * 4.0).round() as u16,
+                bold,
+                italic,
+            };
+            let mut inner = self.inner.borrow_mut();
+            if let Some(layout) = inner.cache.get(&key) {
+                return Some(layout.clone());
+            }
+            let layout = compute_layout(&inner.factory, &inner.families, &key)?;
+            inner.cache.insert(key, layout.clone());
+            Some(layout)
+        }
+        #[cfg(not(windows))]
+        {
+            let _ = (font, text, font_size_px, bold, italic);
+            None
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn compute_layout(
+    factory: &windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: &UiFontFamilies,
+    key: &LayoutKey,
+) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+    use windows::core::PCWSTR;
+    use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+        DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL,
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR, DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS,
+        DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS, DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP,
+    };
+
+    let family = match key.font {
+        UiFontKind::Sans => &families.sans,
+        UiFontKind::Serif => &families.serif,
+    };
+    let family_wide = wide(family);
+    let locale = wide("en-US");
+    let utf16: Vec<u16> = key.text.encode_utf16().collect();
+
+    let weight = if key.bold {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR
+    };
+    let style = if key.italic {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL
+    };
+    let font_size_px = key.size_q4 as f32 / 4.0;
+
+    let format = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextFormat(
+                PCWSTR(family_wide.as_ptr()),
+                None,
+                weight,
+                style,
+                DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL,
+                font_size_px,
+                PCWSTR(locale.as_ptr()),
+            )
+            .ok()?
+    };
+    let _ = unsafe { format.SetWordWrapping(DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP) };
+
+    let layout = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextLayout(&utf16, &format, 4096.0, 4096.0)
+            .ok()?
+    };
+
+    let mut metrics = DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS::default();
+    unsafe { layout.GetMetrics(&mut metrics).ok()? };
+
+    let mut glyph_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(key.text.chars().count());
+    let mut utf16_index = 0u32;
+    for ch in key.text.chars() {
+        let mut x = 0.0f32;
+        let mut y = 0.0f32;
+        let mut hit = DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS::default();
+        unsafe {
+            layout
+                .HitTestTextPosition(utf16_index, false, &mut x, &mut y, &mut hit)
+                .ok()?;
+        }
+        glyph_offsets.push(x);
+        utf16_index += ch.len_utf16() as u32;
+    }
+
+    Some(UiTextLayout {
+        width: metrics.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace.max(metrics.width),
+        line_height: metrics.height.max(font_size_px),
+        glyph_offsets,
+    })
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn wide(value: &str) -> Vec<u16> {
+    value.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect()
+}

+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_font_bundle(candidates: &[&str], label: &str) -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    use godly_terminal_surface::directwrite_rasterizer::DirectWriteRasterizer;
+
+    for family in candidates {
+        let mut dw = DirectWriteRasterizer::new().ok()?;
+        if dw.load_system_font(family).is_ok() {
+            log::info!("[FONT] {label}: {family}");
+            return Some(UiFontBundle {
+                family: (*family).to_string(),
+                rasterizer: Box::new(dw),
+            });
+        }
+    }
+    log::warn!("[FONT] No {label} font available from candidates: {}", candidates.join(", "));
+    None
+}

+    fn layout_text(
+        &self,
+        font_kind: UiFontKind,
+        s: &str,
+        scale: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> UiTextLayout {
+        if let Some(engine) = &self.layout_engine {
+            if let Some(layout) =
+                engine.layout(font_kind, s, self.font_size_px * scale, bold, italic)
+            {
+                return layout;
+            }
+        }
+
+        let advance = if self.ui_avg_advance > 0.0 {
+            self.ui_avg_advance * scale
+        } else {
+            self.cell_width * 0.75 * scale
+        };
+        let mut glyph_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(s.chars().count());
+        let mut x = 0.0;
+        for _ in s.chars() {
+            glyph_offsets.push(x);
+            x += advance;
+        }
+        UiTextLayout {
+            width: x,
+            line_height: self.font_size_px * scale,
+            glyph_offsets,
+        }
+    }
+}

+use std::cell::RefCell;
+use std::collections::HashMap;
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+pub enum UiFontKind {
+    Sans,
+    Serif,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiTextLayout {
+    pub width: f32,
+    pub line_height: f32,
+    pub glyph_offsets: Vec<f32>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiFontFamilies {
+    pub sans: String,
+    pub serif: String,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+struct LayoutKey {
+    font: UiFontKind,
+    text: String,
+    size_q4: u16,
+    bold: bool,
+    italic: bool,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+struct LayoutCache {
+    factory: windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: UiFontFamilies,
+    cache: HashMap<LayoutKey, UiTextLayout>,
+}
+
+pub struct UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    inner: RefCell<LayoutCache>,
+}
+
+impl UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    pub fn new(families: UiFontFamilies) -> windows::core::Result<Self> {
+        use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+            DWriteCreateFactory, DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED, IDWriteFactory,
+        };
+
+        let factory: IDWriteFactory = unsafe { DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED)? };
+        Ok(Self {
+            inner: RefCell::new(LayoutCache {
+                factory,
+                families,
+                cache: HashMap::new(),
+            }),
+        })
+    }
+
+    #[cfg(not(windows))]
+    pub fn new(_families: UiFontFamilies) -> Result<Self, ()> {
+        Ok(Self {})
+    }
+
+    pub fn layout(
+        &self,
+        font: UiFontKind,
+        text: &str,
+        font_size_px: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+        #[cfg(windows)]
+        {
+            let key = LayoutKey {
+                font,
+                text: text.to_string(),
+                size_q4: (font_size_px.max(0.0) * 4.0).round() as u16,
+                bold,
+                italic,
+            };
+            let mut inner = self.inner.borrow_mut();
+            if let Some(layout) = inner.cache.get(&key) {
+                return Some(layout.clone());
+            }
+            let layout = compute_layout(&inner.factory, &inner.families, &key)?;
+            inner.cache.insert(key, layout.clone());
+            Some(layout)
+        }
+        #[cfg(not(windows))]
+        {
+            let _ = (font, text, font_size_px, bold, italic);
+            None
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn compute_layout(
+    factory: &windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: &UiFontFamilies,
+    key: &LayoutKey,
+) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+    use windows::core::PCWSTR;
+    use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+        DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL,
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR, DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS,
+        DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS, DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP,
+    };
+
+    let family = match key.font {
+        UiFontKind::Sans => &families.sans,
+        UiFontKind::Serif => &families.serif,
+    };
+    let family_wide = wide(family);
+    let locale = wide("en-US");
+    let utf16: Vec<u16> = key.text.encode_utf16().collect();
+
+    let weight = if key.bold {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR
+    };
+    let style = if key.italic {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL
+    };
+    let font_size_px = key.size_q4 as f32 / 4.0;
+
+    let format = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextFormat(
+                PCWSTR(family_wide.as_ptr()),
+                None,
+                weight,
+                style,
+                DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL,
+                font_size_px,
+                PCWSTR(locale.as_ptr()),
+            )
+            .ok()?
+    };
+    let _ = unsafe { format.SetWordWrapping(DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP) };
+
+    let layout = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextLayout(&utf16, &format, 4096.0, 4096.0)
+            .ok()?
+    };
+
+    let mut metrics = DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS::default();
+    unsafe { layout.GetMetrics(&mut metrics).ok()? };
+
+    let mut glyph_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(key.text.chars().count());
+    let mut utf16_index = 0u32;
+    for ch in key.text.chars() {
+        let mut x = 0.0f32;
+        let mut y = 0.0f32;
+        let mut hit = DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS::default();
+        unsafe {
+            layout
+                .HitTestTextPosition(utf16_index, false, &mut x, &mut y, &mut hit)
+                .ok()?;
+        }
+        glyph_offsets.push(x);
+        utf16_index += ch.len_utf16() as u32;
+    }
+
+    Some(UiTextLayout {
+        width: metrics.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace.max(metrics.width),
+        line_height: metrics.height.max(font_size_px),
+        glyph_offsets,
+    })
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn wide(value: &str) -> Vec<u16> {
+    value.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect()
+}

+struct UiFontBundle {
+    family: String,
+    rasterizer: Box<dyn godly_terminal_surface::glyph_rasterizer::GlyphRasterizer>,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_font_bundle(candidates: &[&str], label: &str) -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    use godly_terminal_surface::directwrite_rasterizer::DirectWriteRasterizer;
+
+    for family in candidates {
+        let mut dw = DirectWriteRasterizer::new().ok()?;
+        if dw.load_system_font(family).is_ok() {
+            log::info!("[FONT] {label}: {family}");
+            return Some(UiFontBundle {
+                family: (*family).to_string(),
+                rasterizer: Box::new(dw),
+            });
+        }
+    }
+    log::warn!("[FONT] No {label} font available from candidates: {}", candidates.join(", "));
+    None
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_sans_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    create_ui_font_bundle(&["Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI"], "UI sans font")
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_serif_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    create_ui_font_bundle(&["Georgia", "Cambria", "Times New Roman"], "UI serif font")
+}
+
+#[cfg(not(windows))]
+fn create_ui_sans_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    None
+}
+
+#[cfg(not(windows))]
+fn create_ui_serif_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    None
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_text_layout_engine(
+    families: ui::text_layout::UiFontFamilies,
+) -> Option<ui::text_layout::UiTextLayoutEngine> {
+    ui::text_layout::UiTextLayoutEngine::new(families).ok()
+}
+
+#[cfg(not(windows))]
+fn create_ui_text_layout_engine(
+    _families: ui::text_layout::UiFontFamilies,
+) -> Option<ui::text_layout::UiTextLayoutEngine> {
+    None
+}

+    fn push_text_command(
+        &mut self,
+        renderer: &UiTextRenderer,
+        text: &str,
+        x: f32,
+        y: f32,
+        fg: [f32; 4],
+        bg: [f32; 4],
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+        scale: f32,
+        font_kind: TextFontKind,
+        composite: TextCompositeMode,
+    ) {
+        let glyph_offsets = renderer.glyph_offsets_ui(text, scale, bold, italic, font_kind);
+        self.text_commands.push(TextCommand {
+            text: text.to_string(),
+            x,
+            y,
+            fg,
+            bg,
+            bold,
+            font_kind,
+            italic,
+            scale,
+            glyph_offsets,
+            composite,
+        });
+    }

+use std::cell::RefCell;
+use std::collections::HashMap;
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+pub enum UiFontKind {
+    Sans,
+    Serif,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiTextLayout {
+    pub width: f32,
+    pub line_height: f32,
+    pub glyph_offsets: Vec<f32>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiFontFamilies {
+    pub sans: String,
+    pub serif: String,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+struct LayoutKey {
+    font: UiFontKind,
+    text: String,
+    size_q4: u16,
+    bold: bool,
+    italic: bool,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+struct LayoutCache {
+    factory: windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: UiFontFamilies,
+    cache: HashMap<LayoutKey, UiTextLayout>,
+}
+
+pub struct UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    inner: RefCell<LayoutCache>,
+}
+
+impl UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    pub fn new(families: UiFontFamilies) -> windows::core::Result<Self> {
+        use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+            DWriteCreateFactory, DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED, IDWriteFactory,
+        };
+
+        let factory: IDWriteFactory = unsafe { DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED)? };
+        Ok(Self {
+            inner: RefCell::new(LayoutCache {
+                factory,
+                families,
+                cache: HashMap::new(),
+            }),
+        })
+    }
+
+    #[cfg(not(windows))]
+    pub fn new(_families: UiFontFamilies) -> Result<Self, ()> {
+        Ok(Self {})
+    }
+
+    pub fn layout(
+        &self,
+        font: UiFontKind,
+        text: &str,
+        font_size_px: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+        #[cfg(windows)]
+        {
+            let key = LayoutKey {
+                font,
+                text: text.to_string(),
+                size_q4: (font_size_px.max(0.0) * 4.0).round() as u16,
+                bold,
+                italic,
+            };
+            let mut inner = self.inner.borrow_mut();
+            if let Some(layout) = inner.cache.get(&key) {
+                return Some(layout.clone());
+            }
+            let layout = compute_layout(&inner.factory, &inner.families, &key)?;
+            inner.cache.insert(key, layout.clone());
+            Some(layout)
+        }
+        #[cfg(not(windows))]
+        {
+            let _ = (font, text, font_size_px, bold, italic);
+            None
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn compute_layout(
+    factory: &windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: &UiFontFamilies,
+    key: &LayoutKey,
+) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+    use windows::core::PCWSTR;
+    use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+        DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL,
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR, DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS,
+        DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS, DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP,
+    };
+
+    let family = match key.font {
+        UiFontKind::Sans => &families.sans,
+        UiFontKind::Serif => &families.serif,
+    };
+    let family_wide = wide(family);
+    let locale = wide("en-US");
+    let utf16: Vec<u16> = key.text.encode_utf16().collect();
+
+    let weight = if key.bold {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR
+    };
+    let style = if key.italic {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL
+    };
+    let font_size_px = key.size_q4 as f32 / 4.0;
+
+    let format = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextFormat(
+                PCWSTR(family_wide.as_ptr()),
+                None,
+                weight,
+                style,
+                DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL,
+                font_size_px,
+                PCWSTR(locale.as_ptr()),
+            )
+            .ok()?
+    };
+    let _ = unsafe { format.SetWordWrapping(DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP) };
+
+    let layout = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextLayout(&utf16, &format, 4096.0, 4096.0)
+            .ok()?
+    };
+
+    let mut metrics = DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS::default();
+    unsafe { layout.GetMetrics(&mut metrics).ok()? };
+
+    let mut glyph_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(key.text.chars().count());
+    let mut utf16_index = 0u32;
+    for ch in key.text.chars() {
+        let mut x = 0.0f32;
+        let mut y = 0.0f32;
+        let mut hit = DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS::default();
+        unsafe {
+            layout
+                .HitTestTextPosition(utf16_index, false, &mut x, &mut y, &mut hit)
+                .ok()?;
+        }
+        glyph_offsets.push(x);
+        utf16_index += ch.len_utf16() as u32;
+    }
+
+    Some(UiTextLayout {
+        width: metrics.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace.max(metrics.width),
+        line_height: metrics.height.max(font_size_px),
+        glyph_offsets,
+    })
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn wide(value: &str) -> Vec<u16> {
+    value.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect()
+}

+impl GlyphKey {
+    pub fn new(ch: char, font_size: f32, bold: bool, italic: bool) -> Self {
+        Self::new_font(ch, font_size, bold, italic, 0)
+    }
+
+    pub fn new_font(ch: char, font_size: f32, bold: bool, italic: bool, font_id: u8) -> Self {
+        Self {
+            codepoint: ch,
+            size_q4: (font_size * 4.0) as u16,
+            bold,
+            italic,
+            font_id,
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// Create a key for UI font glyphs (proportional sans-serif).
+    pub fn new_ui(ch: char, font_size: f32, bold: bool) -> Self {
+        Self::new_font(ch, font_size, bold, false, 1)
+    }
+
+    pub fn new_ui_serif(ch: char, font_size: f32, bold: bool, italic: bool) -> Self {
+        Self::new_font(ch, font_size, bold, italic, 2)
+    }
+}

+struct UiFontBundle {
+    family: String,
+    rasterizer: Box<dyn godly_terminal_surface::glyph_rasterizer::GlyphRasterizer>,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_font_bundle(candidates: &[&str], label: &str) -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    use godly_terminal_surface::directwrite_rasterizer::DirectWriteRasterizer;
+
+    for family in candidates {
+        let mut dw = DirectWriteRasterizer::new().ok()?;
+        if dw.load_system_font(family).is_ok() {
+            log::info!("[FONT] {label}: {family}");
+            return Some(UiFontBundle {
+                family: (*family).to_string(),
+                rasterizer: Box::new(dw),
+            });
+        }
+    }
+    log::warn!("[FONT] No {label} font available from candidates: {}", candidates.join(", "));
+    None
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_sans_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    create_ui_font_bundle(&["Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI"], "UI sans font")
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_serif_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    create_ui_font_bundle(&["Georgia", "Cambria", "Times New Roman"], "UI serif font")
+}
+
+#[cfg(not(windows))]
+fn create_ui_sans_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {

+#[cfg(not(windows))]

+use std::cell::RefCell;
+use std::collections::HashMap;
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+pub enum UiFontKind {
+    Sans,
+    Serif,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiTextLayout {
+    pub width: f32,
+    pub line_height: f32,
+    pub glyph_offsets: Vec<f32>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiFontFamilies {
+    pub sans: String,
+    pub serif: String,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+struct LayoutKey {
+    font: UiFontKind,
+    text: String,
+    size_q4: u16,
+    bold: bool,
+    italic: bool,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+struct LayoutCache {
+    factory: windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: UiFontFamilies,
+    cache: HashMap<LayoutKey, UiTextLayout>,
+}
+
+pub struct UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    inner: RefCell<LayoutCache>,
+}
+
+impl UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    pub fn new(families: UiFontFamilies) -> windows::core::Result<Self> {
+        use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+            DWriteCreateFactory, DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED, IDWriteFactory,
+        };
+
+        let factory: IDWriteFactory = unsafe { DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED)? };
+        Ok(Self {
+            inner: RefCell::new(LayoutCache {
+                factory,
+                families,
+                cache: HashMap::new(),
+            }),
+        })
+    }
+
+    #[cfg(not(windows))]
+    pub fn new(_families: UiFontFamilies) -> Result<Self, ()> {
+        Ok(Self {})
+    }
+
+    pub fn layout(
+        &self,
+        font: UiFontKind,
+        text: &str,
+        font_size_px: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+        #[cfg(windows)]
+        {
+            let key = LayoutKey {
+                font,
+                text: text.to_string(),
+                size_q4: (font_size_px.max(0.0) * 4.0).round() as u16,
+                bold,
+                italic,
+            };
+            let mut inner = self.inner.borrow_mut();
+            if let Some(layout) = inner.cache.get(&key) {
+                return Some(layout.clone());
+            }
+            let layout = compute_layout(&inner.factory, &inner.families, &key)?;
+            inner.cache.insert(key, layout.clone());
+            Some(layout)
+        }
+        #[cfg(not(windows))]
+        {
+            let _ = (font, text, font_size_px, bold, italic);
+            None
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn compute_layout(
+    factory: &windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: &UiFontFamilies,
+    key: &LayoutKey,
+) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+    use windows::core::PCWSTR;
+    use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+        DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL,
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR, DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS,
+        DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS, DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP,
+    };
+
+    let family = match key.font {
+        UiFontKind::Sans => &families.sans,
+        UiFontKind::Serif => &families.serif,
+    };
+    let family_wide = wide(family);
+    let locale = wide("en-US");
+    let utf16: Vec<u16> = key.text.encode_utf16().collect();
+
+    let weight = if key.bold {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR
+    };
+    let style = if key.italic {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL
+    };
+    let font_size_px = key.size_q4 as f32 / 4.0;
+
+    let format = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextFormat(
+                PCWSTR(family_wide.as_ptr()),
+                None,
+                weight,
+                style,
+                DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL,
+                font_size_px,
+                PCWSTR(locale.as_ptr()),
+            )
+            .ok()?
+    };
+    let _ = unsafe { format.SetWordWrapping(DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP) };
+
+    let layout = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextLayout(&utf16, &format, 4096.0, 4096.0)
+            .ok()?
+    };
+
+    let mut metrics = DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS::default();
+    unsafe { layout.GetMetrics(&mut metrics).ok()? };
+
+    let mut glyph_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(key.text.chars().count());
+    let mut utf16_index = 0u32;
+    for ch in key.text.chars() {
+        let mut x = 0.0f32;
+        let mut y = 0.0f32;
+        let mut hit = DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS::default();
+        unsafe {
+            layout
+                .HitTestTextPosition(utf16_index, false, &mut x, &mut y, &mut hit)
+                .ok()?;
+        }
+        glyph_offsets.push(x);
+        utf16_index += ch.len_utf16() as u32;
+    }
+
+    Some(UiTextLayout {
+        width: metrics.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace.max(metrics.width),
+        line_height: metrics.height.max(font_size_px),
+        glyph_offsets,
+    })
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn wide(value: &str) -> Vec<u16> {
+    value.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect()
+}

+        }
+    }
+

+    pub fn new_ui(ch: char, font_size: f32, bold: bool) -> Self {
+        Self::new_font(ch, font_size, bold, false, 1)
+    }
+
+    pub fn new_ui_serif(ch: char, font_size: f32, bold: bool, italic: bool) -> Self {
+        Self::new_font(ch, font_size, bold, italic, 2)
+    }
+}

+struct UiFontBundle {
+    family: String,
+    rasterizer: Box<dyn godly_terminal_surface::glyph_rasterizer::GlyphRasterizer>,

+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_font_bundle(candidates: &[&str], label: &str) -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    use godly_terminal_surface::directwrite_rasterizer::DirectWriteRasterizer;
+
+    for family in candidates {
+        let mut dw = DirectWriteRasterizer::new().ok()?;
+        if dw.load_system_font(family).is_ok() {
+            log::info!("[FONT] {label}: {family}");
+            return Some(UiFontBundle {
+                family: (*family).to_string(),
+                rasterizer: Box::new(dw),
+            });
+        }
+    }
+    log::warn!("[FONT] No {label} font available from candidates: {}", candidates.join(", "));
+    None
+}
+

+use std::cell::RefCell;
+use std::collections::HashMap;
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+pub enum UiFontKind {
+    Sans,
+    Serif,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiTextLayout {
+    pub width: f32,
+    pub line_height: f32,
+    pub glyph_offsets: Vec<f32>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiFontFamilies {
+    pub sans: String,
+    pub serif: String,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+struct LayoutKey {
+    font: UiFontKind,
+    text: String,
+    size_q4: u16,
+    bold: bool,
+    italic: bool,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+struct LayoutCache {
+    factory: windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: UiFontFamilies,
+    cache: HashMap<LayoutKey, UiTextLayout>,
+}
+
+pub struct UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    inner: RefCell<LayoutCache>,
+}
+
+impl UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    pub fn new(families: UiFontFamilies) -> windows::core::Result<Self> {
+        use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+            DWriteCreateFactory, DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED, IDWriteFactory,
+        };
+
+        let factory: IDWriteFactory = unsafe { DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED)? };
+        Ok(Self {
+            inner: RefCell::new(LayoutCache {
+                factory,
+                families,
+                cache: HashMap::new(),
+            }),
+        })
+    }
+
+    #[cfg(not(windows))]
+    pub fn new(_families: UiFontFamilies) -> Result<Self, ()> {
+        Ok(Self {})
+    }
+
+    pub fn layout(
+        &self,
+        font: UiFontKind,
+        text: &str,
+        font_size_px: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+        #[cfg(windows)]
+        {
+            let key = LayoutKey {
+                font,
+                text: text.to_string(),
+                size_q4: (font_size_px.max(0.0) * 4.0).round() as u16,
+                bold,
+                italic,
+            };
+            let mut inner = self.inner.borrow_mut();
+            if let Some(layout) = inner.cache.get(&key) {
+                return Some(layout.clone());
+            }
+            let layout = compute_layout(&inner.factory, &inner.families, &key)?;
+            inner.cache.insert(key, layout.clone());
+            Some(layout)
+        }
+        #[cfg(not(windows))]
+        {
+            let _ = (font, text, font_size_px, bold, italic);
+            None
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn compute_layout(
+    factory: &windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: &UiFontFamilies,
+    key: &LayoutKey,
+) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+    use windows::core::PCWSTR;
+    use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+        DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL,
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR, DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS,
+        DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS, DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP,
+    };
+
+    let family = match key.font {
+        UiFontKind::Sans => &families.sans,
+        UiFontKind::Serif => &families.serif,
+    };
+    let family_wide = wide(family);
+    let locale = wide("en-US");
+    let utf16: Vec<u16> = key.text.encode_utf16().collect();
+
+    let weight = if key.bold {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR
+    };
+    let style = if key.italic {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL
+    };
+    let font_size_px = key.size_q4 as f32 / 4.0;
+
+    let format = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextFormat(
+                PCWSTR(family_wide.as_ptr()),
+                None,
+                weight,
+                style,
+                DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL,
+                font_size_px,
+                PCWSTR(locale.as_ptr()),
+            )
+            .ok()?
+    };
+    let _ = unsafe { format.SetWordWrapping(DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP) };
+
+    let layout = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextLayout(&utf16, &format, 4096.0, 4096.0)
+            .ok()?
+    };
+
+    let mut metrics = DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS::default();
+    unsafe { layout.GetMetrics(&mut metrics).ok()? };
+
+    let mut glyph_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(key.text.chars().count());
+    let mut utf16_index = 0u32;
+    for ch in key.text.chars() {
+        let mut x = 0.0f32;
+        let mut y = 0.0f32;
+        let mut hit = DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS::default();
+        unsafe {
+            layout
+                .HitTestTextPosition(utf16_index, false, &mut x, &mut y, &mut hit)
+                .ok()?;
+        }
+        glyph_offsets.push(x);
+        utf16_index += ch.len_utf16() as u32;
+    }
+
+    Some(UiTextLayout {
+        width: metrics.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace.max(metrics.width),
+        line_height: metrics.height.max(font_size_px),
+        glyph_offsets,
+    })
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn wide(value: &str) -> Vec<u16> {
+    value.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect()
+}

+        Self::new_font(ch, font_size, bold, italic, 2)
+    }
+}

+struct UiFontBundle {
+    family: String,
+    rasterizer: Box<dyn godly_terminal_surface::glyph_rasterizer::GlyphRasterizer>,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_font_bundle(candidates: &[&str], label: &str) -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    use godly_terminal_surface::directwrite_rasterizer::DirectWriteRasterizer;
+
+    for family in candidates {
+        let mut dw = DirectWriteRasterizer::new().ok()?;
+        if dw.load_system_font(family).is_ok() {
+            log::info!("[FONT] {label}: {family}");
+            return Some(UiFontBundle {
+                family: (*family).to_string(),
+                rasterizer: Box::new(dw),
+            });
+        }
+    }
+    log::warn!("[FONT] No {label} font available from candidates: {}", candidates.join(", "));
+    None
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_sans_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {

+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_serif_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {

+        &self,
+        font_kind: UiFontKind,
+        s: &str,
+        scale: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> UiTextLayout {
+        if let Some(engine) = &self.layout_engine {
+            if let Some(layout) =
+                engine.layout(font_kind, s, self.font_size_px * scale, bold, italic)
+            {
+                return layout;
+            }
+        }

+        let advance = if self.ui_avg_advance > 0.0 {

+        }

+            width: x,
+            line_height: self.font_size_px * scale,
+            glyph_offsets,
+        }

+use std::cell::RefCell;
+use std::collections::HashMap;
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+pub enum UiFontKind {
+    Sans,
+    Serif,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiTextLayout {
+    pub width: f32,
+    pub line_height: f32,
+    pub glyph_offsets: Vec<f32>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiFontFamilies {
+    pub sans: String,
+    pub serif: String,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+struct LayoutKey {
+    font: UiFontKind,
+    text: String,
+    size_q4: u16,
+    bold: bool,
+    italic: bool,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+struct LayoutCache {
+    factory: windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: UiFontFamilies,
+    cache: HashMap<LayoutKey, UiTextLayout>,
+}
+
+pub struct UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    inner: RefCell<LayoutCache>,
+}
+
+impl UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    pub fn new(families: UiFontFamilies) -> windows::core::Result<Self> {
+        use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+            DWriteCreateFactory, DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED, IDWriteFactory,
+        };
+
+        let factory: IDWriteFactory = unsafe { DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED)? };
+        Ok(Self {
+            inner: RefCell::new(LayoutCache {
+                factory,
+                families,
+                cache: HashMap::new(),
+            }),
+        })
+    }
+
+    #[cfg(not(windows))]
+    pub fn new(_families: UiFontFamilies) -> Result<Self, ()> {
+        Ok(Self {})
+    }
+
+    pub fn layout(
+        &self,
+        font: UiFontKind,
+        text: &str,
+        font_size_px: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+        #[cfg(windows)]
+        {
+            let key = LayoutKey {
+                font,
+                text: text.to_string(),
+                size_q4: (font_size_px.max(0.0) * 4.0).round() as u16,
+                bold,
+                italic,
+            };
+            let mut inner = self.inner.borrow_mut();
+            if let Some(layout) = inner.cache.get(&key) {
+                return Some(layout.clone());
+            }
+            let layout = compute_layout(&inner.factory, &inner.families, &key)?;
+            inner.cache.insert(key, layout.clone());
+            Some(layout)
+        }
+        #[cfg(not(windows))]
+        {
+            let _ = (font, text, font_size_px, bold, italic);
+            None
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn compute_layout(
+    factory: &windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: &UiFontFamilies,
+    key: &LayoutKey,
+) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+    use windows::core::PCWSTR;
+    use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+        DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL,
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR, DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS,
+        DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS, DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP,
+    };
+
+    let family = match key.font {
+        UiFontKind::Sans => &families.sans,
+        UiFontKind::Serif => &families.serif,
+    };
+    let family_wide = wide(family);
+    let locale = wide("en-US");
+    let utf16: Vec<u16> = key.text.encode_utf16().collect();
+
+    let weight = if key.bold {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR
+    };
+    let style = if key.italic {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL
+    };
+    let font_size_px = key.size_q4 as f32 / 4.0;
+
+    let format = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextFormat(
+                PCWSTR(family_wide.as_ptr()),
+                None,
+                weight,
+                style,
+                DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL,
+                font_size_px,
+                PCWSTR(locale.as_ptr()),
+            )
+            .ok()?
+    };
+    let _ = unsafe { format.SetWordWrapping(DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP) };
+
+    let layout = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextLayout(&utf16, &format, 4096.0, 4096.0)
+            .ok()?
+    };
+
+    let mut metrics = DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS::default();
+    unsafe { layout.GetMetrics(&mut metrics).ok()? };
+
+    let mut glyph_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(key.text.chars().count());
+    let mut utf16_index = 0u32;
+    for ch in key.text.chars() {
+        let mut x = 0.0f32;
+        let mut y = 0.0f32;
+        let mut hit = DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS::default();
+        unsafe {
+            layout
+                .HitTestTextPosition(utf16_index, false, &mut x, &mut y, &mut hit)
+                .ok()?;
+        }
+        glyph_offsets.push(x);
+        utf16_index += ch.len_utf16() as u32;
+    }
+
+    Some(UiTextLayout {
+        width: metrics.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace.max(metrics.width),
+        line_height: metrics.height.max(font_size_px),
+        glyph_offsets,
+    })
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn wide(value: &str) -> Vec<u16> {
+    value.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect()
+}

+        Self::new_font(ch, font_size, bold, italic, 2)
+    }
+}

+struct UiFontBundle {
+    family: String,
+    rasterizer: Box<dyn godly_terminal_surface::glyph_rasterizer::GlyphRasterizer>,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_font_bundle(candidates: &[&str], label: &str) -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    use godly_terminal_surface::directwrite_rasterizer::DirectWriteRasterizer;
+
+    for family in candidates {
+        let mut dw = DirectWriteRasterizer::new().ok()?;
+        if dw.load_system_font(family).is_ok() {
+            log::info!("[FONT] {label}: {family}");
+            return Some(UiFontBundle {
+                family: (*family).to_string(),
+                rasterizer: Box::new(dw),
+            });
+        }
+    }
+    log::warn!("[FONT] No {label} font available from candidates: {}", candidates.join(", "));
+    None
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_sans_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    create_ui_font_bundle(&["Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI"], "UI sans font")

+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_serif_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {

+    pub fn glyph_offsets_ui(
+        &self,
+        s: &str,
+        scale: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+        font_kind: TextFontKind,
+    ) -> Vec<f32> {
+        match font_kind {
+            TextFontKind::TerminalMono => Vec::new(),
+            TextFontKind::UiSans => self
+                .layout_text(UiFontKind::Sans, s, scale, bold, italic)
+                .glyph_offsets,
+            TextFontKind::UiSerif => self
+                .layout_text(UiFontKind::Serif, s, scale, bold, italic)
+                .glyph_offsets,
+        }

+    fn layout_text(
+        &self,
+        font_kind: UiFontKind,
+        s: &str,
+        scale: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> UiTextLayout {
+        if let Some(engine) = &self.layout_engine {
+            if let Some(layout) =
+                engine.layout(font_kind, s, self.font_size_px * scale, bold, italic)
+            {
+                return layout;
+            }
+        }
+
+        let advance = if self.ui_avg_advance > 0.0 {
+            self.ui_avg_advance * scale
+        } else {
+            self.cell_width * 0.75 * scale
+        };
+        let mut glyph_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(s.chars().count());
+        let mut x = 0.0;
+        for _ in s.chars() {
+            glyph_offsets.push(x);
+            x += advance;
+        }
+        UiTextLayout {
+            width: x,
+            line_height: self.font_size_px * scale,
+            glyph_offsets,
+        }
+    }

+use std::cell::RefCell;
+use std::collections::HashMap;
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+pub enum UiFontKind {
+    Sans,
+    Serif,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiTextLayout {
+    pub width: f32,
+    pub line_height: f32,
+    pub glyph_offsets: Vec<f32>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiFontFamilies {
+    pub sans: String,
+    pub serif: String,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+struct LayoutKey {
+    font: UiFontKind,
+    text: String,
+    size_q4: u16,
+    bold: bool,
+    italic: bool,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+struct LayoutCache {
+    factory: windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: UiFontFamilies,
+    cache: HashMap<LayoutKey, UiTextLayout>,
+}
+
+pub struct UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    inner: RefCell<LayoutCache>,
+}
+
+impl UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    pub fn new(families: UiFontFamilies) -> windows::core::Result<Self> {
+        use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+            DWriteCreateFactory, DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED, IDWriteFactory,
+        };
+
+        let factory: IDWriteFactory = unsafe { DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED)? };
+        Ok(Self {
+            inner: RefCell::new(LayoutCache {
+                factory,
+                families,
+                cache: HashMap::new(),
+            }),
+        })
+    }
+
+    #[cfg(not(windows))]
+    pub fn new(_families: UiFontFamilies) -> Result<Self, ()> {
+        Ok(Self {})
+    }
+
+    pub fn layout(
+        &self,
+        font: UiFontKind,
+        text: &str,
+        font_size_px: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+        #[cfg(windows)]
+        {
+            let key = LayoutKey {
+                font,
+                text: text.to_string(),
+                size_q4: (font_size_px.max(0.0) * 4.0).round() as u16,
+                bold,
+                italic,
+            };
+            let mut inner = self.inner.borrow_mut();
+            if let Some(layout) = inner.cache.get(&key) {
+                return Some(layout.clone());
+            }
+            let layout = compute_layout(&inner.factory, &inner.families, &key)?;
+            inner.cache.insert(key, layout.clone());
+            Some(layout)
+        }
+        #[cfg(not(windows))]
+        {
+            let _ = (font, text, font_size_px, bold, italic);
+            None
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn compute_layout(
+    factory: &windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: &UiFontFamilies,
+    key: &LayoutKey,
+) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+    use windows::core::PCWSTR;
+    use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+        DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL,
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR, DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS,
+        DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS, DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP,
+    };
+
+    let family = match key.font {
+        UiFontKind::Sans => &families.sans,
+        UiFontKind::Serif => &families.serif,
+    };
+    let family_wide = wide(family);
+    let locale = wide("en-US");
+    let utf16: Vec<u16> = key.text.encode_utf16().collect();
+
+    let weight = if key.bold {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR
+    };
+    let style = if key.italic {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL
+    };
+    let font_size_px = key.size_q4 as f32 / 4.0;
+
+    let format = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextFormat(
+                PCWSTR(family_wide.as_ptr()),
+                None,
+                weight,
+                style,
+                DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL,
+                font_size_px,
+                PCWSTR(locale.as_ptr()),
+            )
+            .ok()?
+    };
+    let _ = unsafe { format.SetWordWrapping(DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP) };
+
+    let layout = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextLayout(&utf16, &format, 4096.0, 4096.0)
+            .ok()?
+    };
+
+    let mut metrics = DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS::default();
+    unsafe { layout.GetMetrics(&mut metrics).ok()? };
+
+    let mut glyph_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(key.text.chars().count());
+    let mut utf16_index = 0u32;
+    for ch in key.text.chars() {
+        let mut x = 0.0f32;
+        let mut y = 0.0f32;
+        let mut hit = DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS::default();
+        unsafe {
+            layout
+                .HitTestTextPosition(utf16_index, false, &mut x, &mut y, &mut hit)
+                .ok()?;
+        }
+        glyph_offsets.push(x);
+        utf16_index += ch.len_utf16() as u32;
+    }
+
+    Some(UiTextLayout {
+        width: metrics.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace.max(metrics.width),
+        line_height: metrics.height.max(font_size_px),
+        glyph_offsets,
+    })
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn wide(value: &str) -> Vec<u16> {
+    value.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect()
+}

+        Self::new_font(ch, font_size, bold, false, 1)
+    }
+
+    pub fn new_ui_serif(ch: char, font_size: f32, bold: bool, italic: bool) -> Self {
+        Self::new_font(ch, font_size, bold, italic, 2)
+    }
+}

# Rendering Quality Iteration Log

Target: Match Windows Terminal / Zed quality (pixel-perfect, crisp text)

## Iteration 79 ÔÇö Retained Shell Layout + Real Diff Harness

**Goal**: Stop spending iterations on top-level hand-authored rectangle math,
and make the screenshot comparison path measurable instead of anecdotal.

**Changes made**:

1. **Retained `taffy` shell layout** (`ui/layout.rs`, `main.rs`) ÔÇö Replaced
   the top-level manual `ShellLayout::compute()` region solver with a retained
   `ShellLayoutEngine` backed by `taffy::TaffyTree`. The shell regions
   (tab bar, body, sidebar, center column, right panel, status bar) now come
   from flex layout, and `main.rs` routes render/input/resize queries through
   the retained engine.

2. **Layout regression tests** (`ui/layout.rs`) ÔÇö Added focused tests for
   visible, hidden, and scaled configurations. Verified with:
   `cargo test -p godly-shell ui::layout -- --nocapture`

3. **Screenshot diff harness** (`scripts/check-pixels.ps1`) ÔÇö Replaced the
   previous fixed-coordinate probe script with full-image comparison that
   outputs:
   - changed-pixel counts
   - pixels-over-threshold counts
   - max channel delta
   - MAE / RMSE
   - `current-godly-shell.diff.png`

4. **DPI-aware native screenshot capture** (`scripts/take-screenshot-now.ps1`)
   ÔÇö The helper now opts into `PER_MONITOR_AWARE_V2` before querying screen
   bounds, so native captures use physical pixels instead of logical pixels.
   This fixed the old `1707x960` vs `2560x1440` mismatch on the native side.

5. **Fresh measured baseline** ÔÇö Captured a new web reference from the local
   Vite app and a fresh native screenshot, then ran the new harness:
   - size: `2560x1440`
   - changed: `3,686,400 px (100%)`
   - pixels over 10: `3,684,752 px (99.9553%)`
   - MAE: `0.350239`
   - RMSE: `0.500536`
   - max channel diff: `245`

**Result**: The repo now has a retained top-level layout layer and a real
visual-parity harness. The numbers confirm the remaining gap is still large,
and that the next blockers are physical-pixel presentation, real UI text
layout, and background-aware text compositing ÔÇö not palette polish.

## Iteration 78 ÔÇö Synthetic Italic, Color Accuracy, Demo Parity

**Goal**: Fix remaining color mismatches, add synthetic italic for poem
stanzas, and match demo data/state to web reference exactly.

**Changes made**:

1. **FG_INACTIVE color (#9198a1)** ÔÇö Web uses #9198a1 for inactive session
   names and agent names, but native was using FG_SECONDARY (#8b949e). Added
   FG_INACTIVE constant and updated sidebar session names + agent names.

2. **Synthetic italic for poem stanzas** ÔÇö Added `skew` field to TextCommand
   and `text_ui_italic_scaled()` to UiBuilder. Renderer shifts top vertices
   of glyph quads rightward by `skew * height` (~12┬░ slant). Poem stanzas
   now render with synthetic italic, approximating web's Georgia serif italic.

3. **Agent demo data matched** ÔÇö Agent 2 name "anu" ÔåÆ "amp", descriptions
   matched to web ("Verify and clean README documentation", "Verify README
   against codebase"), claude-code agent has no description.

4. **Streaming status bar** ÔÇö Set streaming=true in demo init to match web
   reference which shows "~ Streaming response... Esc to cancel".

**Result**: Inactive text colors now match web exactly. Poem has visible
italic styling. Status bar matches web demo state. Agent panel data matches.

## Iteration 77 ÔÇö Fix Monospace/Proportional Font Mismatches

**Goal**: Fix remaining places where UI chrome text was still using the monospace
terminal font at full 14px instead of the proportional UI font at the correct
scaled size from the web reference.

**Changes made**:

1. **Tab badge count text** ÔÇö Badge count numbers ("3", "12") on tabs were
   rendered using `ui.text()` (monospace, 14px) instead of proportional bold
   at 9px. Changed to `ui.text_ui_bold_scaled()` with `font_scale::PX9`,
   matching web's `fontSize: 9, fontWeight: 700`. Also fixed text width
   measurement (`text_width_ui_scaled`) and vertical centering calculation.

2. **PX9 font scale constant** ÔÇö Added `PX9 = 9.0 / 14.0` (0.643) to the
   `font_scale` module for badge count text.

3. **Session ID numbers** ÔÇö Numbers (1, 2, 3) before session names in the
   sidebar were rendered using `ui.text()` (monospace, 14px) but web uses
   `fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 500`. Changed to `ui.text_ui_scaled()` with
   `font_scale::PX12`.

**Result**: All remaining monospace-font-in-UI-chrome text has been eliminated.
Tab badge counts are now correctly sized at 9px proportional bold (matching
web's Badge component), and session numbers use 12px proportional (matching
web's session list styling). These were the last places using monospace text
for UI chrome elements.

## Iteration 76 ÔÇö Per-Element Font Size Scaling

**Goal**: Match the web reference's per-element font sizes. The native shell was
rendering ALL UI text at 14px (cell_height), but the web uses different sizes
for different elements: 10px for shortcuts/badges, 11px for branch/status bar,
12px for headers/tab titles, 13px for session names/poem stanzas, 15px for
the poem title.

**Changes made**:

1. **Font scaling infrastructure** ÔÇö Added `scale` field to `TextCommand` struct
   (defaults to 1.0). Added `text_ui_scaled()` and `text_ui_bold_scaled()`
   methods to `UiBuilder`. The terminal renderer now multiplies glyph quad
   width/height and advance by the scale factor, enabling per-element font sizes
   without re-rasterizing glyphs in the atlas.

2. **`font_scale` module** ÔÇö Defined constants for common web font sizes relative

## Changes in Iteration 79

1. **Top-level shell layout moved onto retained `taffy` nodes** ÔÇö Replaced the hand-written `ShellLayout::compute()` region solver with a persistent `ShellLayoutEngine` backed by a `taffy::TaffyTree`. The shell now computes tab bar/body/sidebar/center/right panel/status bar through flex layout and only derives `terminal_content` as a post-layout inset. This closes the highest-leverage rectangle-math blocker at the outer shell layer without rewriting every widget in one pass.
2. **App render/input path now routes through the retained layout engine** ÔÇö `main.rs` holds a `RefCell<ShellLayoutEngine>` and all region queries (`terminal_size`, render, hover, resize-handle hit testing, selection routing) now pull from the same retained layout tree instead of rebuilding top-level geometry ad hoc.
3. **Layout verification added** ÔÇö `cargo test -p godly-shell ui::layout -- --nocapture` now exercises the retained layout engine for visible, hidden, and scaled configurations so layout regressions are caught before screenshot comparison.
4. **Screenshot-diff harness is now measurable** ÔÇö `scripts/check-pixels.ps1` was rewritten to compute full-image metrics (`changed_pixels`, `pixels_over_10`, `max_channel_diff`, `MAE`, `RMSE`) and emit `current-godly-shell.diff.png`. This replaces the previous hard-coded spot sampling script.
5. **Native screenshot capture is now DPI-aware** ÔÇö `scripts/take-screenshot-now.ps1` now calls `SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext(PER_MONITOR_AWARE_V2)` before reading screen bounds, so captured screenshots are in physical pixels (`2560x1440` here) rather than logical pixels (`1707x960`).
6. **Measured baseline after the harness landed** ÔÇö Fresh captures at `2560x1440` currently diff at `Changed: 3,686,400 px (100%)`, `Pixels over 10: 3,684,752 px (99.9553%)`, `MAE: 0.350239`, `RMSE: 0.500536`, `Max channel diff: 245`. ## Changes in Iteration 73

1. **DPI scaling fix** ÔÇö wgpu surface now configured at logical resolution instead of physical resolution. On Windows with 150% DPI scaling, the compositor clips the swap chain at the logical pixel boundary (1707px), making content rendered at physical coordinates >1707 invisible. Fixed by computing `logical_w = physical_w / scale_factor` and configuring the surface at that size. Layout now uses `scale_factor=1.0` since all coordinates are in logical pixels. The compositor handles upscaling to physical resolution.
2. **Right panel enabled** ÔÇö The right panel with "The Gardener of Broken Things" poem is now visible. Previously hidden behind `visible: false` due to the DPI clipping issue. Now renders correctly with header, poem stanzas, footer, close button, and bottom status bar matching web reference.

## Remaining Gaps (Priority Order)

### Critical: Physical-pixel presentation is still unresolved
The screenshot helper now captures the native shell in physical pixels, but the renderer
still configures the swap chain at logical resolution (`1707├ù960` / `1707├ù912` region)
and lets the compositor upscale to the physical panel (`2560├ù1440`). That means the
capture harness is finally honest about the gap: the app is still not rendering chrome
or terminal text at native physical-pixel sharpness.

**Investigation status:** iteration 74 already proved that a naive physical-resolution
swap chain is clipped by DWM at the logical boundary. The remaining work is not "flip a
flag"; it likely needs an equivalent presentation path such as off-screen rendering with
an explicit blit/present strategy or lower-level Win32/DXGI control outside the current
wgpu swap-chain path.

### Critical: UI chrome typography is still a faux text-layout path
Chrome text still flows through `TextCommand` + atlas quads with hand-managed positioning:
scaled advances, manual truncation, and per-character placement. The right-panel poem is
still synthetic skew, not a real italic face or real text layout.

**What remains:** wire a real UI text layout path (DirectWrite or equivalent) that owns
measurement, glyph positioning, line height, italics, and truncation instead of relying
on `ui_avg_advance`, `ui_char_advances`, and `text_ui_italic_scaled()`.

### Critical: Chrome text compositing is not background-aware yet
`TerminalRenderer::prepare()` still forces all UI text through the transparent-background
grayscale fallback path. That avoids color fringes on mixed backdrops, but it also means
chrome labels never reach terminal-grade ClearType sharpness even when they sit on flat,
opaque surfaces like the sidebar, status bar, and most of the tab bar.

**What remains:** promote `TextCommand.bg` into a real compositing decision so flat
opaque chrome can use subpixel blending, with grayscale AA reserved only for text drawn
over gradients or mixed backgrounds.

### Major: Retained layout only covers the shell regions so far
The outer shell now uses retained `taffy`, but the internals of the tab bar, sidebar,
status bar, and right panel still do their own manual sub-rect math and hit testing.
This iteration stops the outer rectangle sprawl; it does not yet eliminate the inner one.

**Next layout step:** move at least one chrome section (tab bar or sidebar) onto the
retained layout tree so sizing, alignment, and hit testing stop depending on hand-tuned
pixel math.

### Medium: Reference capture is measurable, but not yet pinned to 1920├ù1080
The parity harness can now compare real screenshots, but the current automated flow is
capturing at the current physical desktop size (`2560├ù1440` here). The loop prompt asks
for a `1920├ù1080` reference capture; that normalization step still needs to be made
deterministic.

+struct UiFontBundle {
+    family: String,
+    rasterizer: Box<dyn godly_terminal_surface::glyph_rasterizer::GlyphRasterizer>,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_font_bundle(candidates: &[&str], label: &str) -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    use godly_terminal_surface::directwrite_rasterizer::DirectWriteRasterizer;
+
+    for family in candidates {
+        let mut dw = DirectWriteRasterizer::new().ok()?;
+        if dw.load_system_font(family).is_ok() {
+            log::info!("[FONT] {label}: {family}");
+            return Some(UiFontBundle {
+                family: (*family).to_string(),
+                rasterizer: Box::new(dw),
+            });
+        }
+    }
+    log::warn!("[FONT] No {label} font available from candidates: {}", candidates.join(", "));
+    None
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_sans_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    create_ui_font_bundle(&["Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI"], "UI sans font")

+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_serif_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {

+    pub fn glyph_offsets_ui(
+        &self,
+        s: &str,
+        scale: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+        font_kind: TextFontKind,
+    ) -> Vec<f32> {
+        match font_kind {
+            TextFontKind::TerminalMono => Vec::new(),
+            TextFontKind::UiSans => self
+                .layout_text(UiFontKind::Sans, s, scale, bold, italic)
+                .glyph_offsets,
+            TextFontKind::UiSerif => self
+                .layout_text(UiFontKind::Serif, s, scale, bold, italic)
+                .glyph_offsets,
+        }

+    fn layout_text(
+        &self,
+        font_kind: UiFontKind,
+        s: &str,
+        scale: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> UiTextLayout {
+        if let Some(engine) = &self.layout_engine {
+            if let Some(layout) =
+                engine.layout(font_kind, s, self.font_size_px * scale, bold, italic)
+            {
+                return layout;
+            }
+        }
+
+        let advance = if self.ui_avg_advance > 0.0 {
+            self.ui_avg_advance * scale
+        } else {
+            self.cell_width * 0.75 * scale
+        };
+        let mut glyph_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(s.chars().count());
+        let mut x = 0.0;
+        for _ in s.chars() {
+            glyph_offsets.push(x);
+            x += advance;
+        }
+        UiTextLayout {
+            width: x,
+            line_height: self.font_size_px * scale,
+            glyph_offsets,
+        }
+    }

+use std::cell::RefCell;
+use std::collections::HashMap;
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+pub enum UiFontKind {
+    Sans,
+    Serif,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiTextLayout {
+    pub width: f32,
+    pub line_height: f32,
+    pub glyph_offsets: Vec<f32>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiFontFamilies {
+    pub sans: String,
+    pub serif: String,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+struct LayoutKey {
+    font: UiFontKind,
+    text: String,
+    size_q4: u16,
+    bold: bool,
+    italic: bool,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+struct LayoutCache {
+    factory: windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: UiFontFamilies,
+    cache: HashMap<LayoutKey, UiTextLayout>,
+}
+
+pub struct UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    inner: RefCell<LayoutCache>,
+}
+
+impl UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    pub fn new(families: UiFontFamilies) -> windows::core::Result<Self> {
+        use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+            DWriteCreateFactory, DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED, IDWriteFactory,
+        };
+
+        let factory: IDWriteFactory = unsafe { DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED)? };
+        Ok(Self {
+            inner: RefCell::new(LayoutCache {
+                factory,
+                families,
+                cache: HashMap::new(),
+            }),
+        })
+    }
+
+    #[cfg(not(windows))]
+    pub fn new(_families: UiFontFamilies) -> Result<Self, ()> {
+        Ok(Self {})
+    }
+
+    pub fn layout(
+        &self,
+        font: UiFontKind,
+        text: &str,
+        font_size_px: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+        #[cfg(windows)]
+        {
+            let key = LayoutKey {
+                font,
+                text: text.to_string(),
+                size_q4: (font_size_px.max(0.0) * 4.0).round() as u16,
+                bold,
+                italic,
+            };
+            let mut inner = self.inner.borrow_mut();
+            if let Some(layout) = inner.cache.get(&key) {
+                return Some(layout.clone());
+            }
+            let layout = compute_layout(&inner.factory, &inner.families, &key)?;
+            inner.cache.insert(key, layout.clone());
+            Some(layout)
+        }
+        #[cfg(not(windows))]
+        {
+            let _ = (font, text, font_size_px, bold, italic);
+            None
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn compute_layout(
+    factory: &windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: &UiFontFamilies,
+    key: &LayoutKey,
+) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+    use windows::core::PCWSTR;
+    use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+        DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL,
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR, DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS,
+        DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS, DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP,
+    };
+
+    let family = match key.font {
+        UiFontKind::Sans => &families.sans,
+        UiFontKind::Serif => &families.serif,
+    };
+    let family_wide = wide(family);
+    let locale = wide("en-US");
+    let utf16: Vec<u16> = key.text.encode_utf16().collect();
+
+    let weight = if key.bold {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR
+    };
+    let style = if key.italic {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL
+    };
+    let font_size_px = key.size_q4 as f32 / 4.0;
+
+    let format = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextFormat(
+                PCWSTR(family_wide.as_ptr()),
+                None,
+                weight,
+                style,
+                DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL,
+                font_size_px,
+                PCWSTR(locale.as_ptr()),
+            )
+            .ok()?
+    };
+    let _ = unsafe { format.SetWordWrapping(DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP) };
+
+    let layout = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextLayout(&utf16, &format, 4096.0, 4096.0)
+            .ok()?
+    };
+
+    let mut metrics = DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS::default();
+    unsafe { layout.GetMetrics(&mut metrics).ok()? };
+
+    let mut glyph_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(key.text.chars().count());
+    let mut utf16_index = 0u32;
+    for ch in key.text.chars() {
+        let mut x = 0.0f32;
+        let mut y = 0.0f32;
+        let mut hit = DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS::default();
+        unsafe {
+            layout
+                .HitTestTextPosition(utf16_index, false, &mut x, &mut y, &mut hit)
+                .ok()?;
+        }
+        glyph_offsets.push(x);
+        utf16_index += ch.len_utf16() as u32;
+    }
+
+    Some(UiTextLayout {
+        width: metrics.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace.max(metrics.width),
+        line_height: metrics.height.max(font_size_px),
+        glyph_offsets,
+    })
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn wide(value: &str) -> Vec<u16> {
+    value.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect()
+}

+        Self::new_font(ch, font_size, bold, italic, 2)
+    }
+}

+struct UiFontBundle {
+    family: String,
+    rasterizer: Box<dyn godly_terminal_surface::glyph_rasterizer::GlyphRasterizer>,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_font_bundle(candidates: &[&str], label: &str) -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    use godly_terminal_surface::directwrite_rasterizer::DirectWriteRasterizer;
+
+    for family in candidates {
+        let mut dw = DirectWriteRasterizer::new().ok()?;
+        if dw.load_system_font(family).is_ok() {
+            log::info!("[FONT] {label}: {family}");
+            return Some(UiFontBundle {
+                family: (*family).to_string(),
+                rasterizer: Box::new(dw),
+            });
+        }
+    }
+    log::warn!("[FONT] No {label} font available from candidates: {}", candidates.join(", "));
+    None
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_sans_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    create_ui_font_bundle(&["Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI"], "UI sans font")

+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_serif_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {

+    /// Exact width of a string rendered in the serif UI font at a given scale.
+    pub fn text_width_serif_scaled(
+        &self,
+        s: &str,
+        scale: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> f32 {
+        self.layout_text(UiFontKind::Serif, s, scale, bold, italic)
+            .width
+    }
+
+    pub fn glyph_offsets_ui(
+        &self,
+        s: &str,
+        scale: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+        font_kind: TextFontKind,
+    ) -> Vec<f32> {
+        match font_kind {
+            TextFontKind::TerminalMono => Vec::new(),
+            TextFontKind::UiSans => self
+                .layout_text(UiFontKind::Sans, s, scale, bold, italic)
+                .glyph_offsets,
+            TextFontKind::UiSerif => self
+                .layout_text(UiFontKind::Serif, s, scale, bold, italic)
+                .glyph_offsets,
+        }
+    }
+
+    fn layout_text(
+        &self,
+        font_kind: UiFontKind,
+        s: &str,
+        scale: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> UiTextLayout {
+        if let Some(engine) = &self.layout_engine {
+            if let Some(layout) =
+                engine.layout(font_kind, s, self.font_size_px * scale, bold, italic)
+            {
+                return layout;
+            }
+        }
+
+        let advance = if self.ui_avg_advance > 0.0 {
+            self.ui_avg_advance * scale
+        } else {
+            self.cell_width * 0.75 * scale
+        };
+        let mut glyph_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(s.chars().count());
+        let mut x = 0.0;
+        for _ in s.chars() {
+            glyph_offsets.push(x);
+            x += advance;
+        }
+        UiTextLayout {
+            width: x,
+            line_height: self.font_size_px * scale,
+            glyph_offsets,
+        }
+    }
+}

+use std::cell::RefCell;
+use std::collections::HashMap;
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+pub enum UiFontKind {
+    Sans,
+    Serif,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiTextLayout {
+    pub width: f32,
+    pub line_height: f32,
+    pub glyph_offsets: Vec<f32>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiFontFamilies {
+    pub sans: String,
+    pub serif: String,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+struct LayoutKey {
+    font: UiFontKind,
+    text: String,
+    size_q4: u16,
+    bold: bool,
+    italic: bool,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+struct LayoutCache {
+    factory: windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: UiFontFamilies,
+    cache: HashMap<LayoutKey, UiTextLayout>,
+}
+
+pub struct UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    inner: RefCell<LayoutCache>,
+}
+
+impl UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    pub fn new(families: UiFontFamilies) -> windows::core::Result<Self> {
+        use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+            DWriteCreateFactory, DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED, IDWriteFactory,
+        };
+
+        let factory: IDWriteFactory = unsafe { DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED)? };
+        Ok(Self {
+            inner: RefCell::new(LayoutCache {
+                factory,
+                families,
+                cache: HashMap::new(),
+            }),
+        })
+    }
+
+    #[cfg(not(windows))]
+    pub fn new(_families: UiFontFamilies) -> Result<Self, ()> {
+        Ok(Self {})
+    }
+
+    pub fn layout(
+        &self,
+        font: UiFontKind,
+        text: &str,
+        font_size_px: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+        #[cfg(windows)]
+        {
+            let key = LayoutKey {
+                font,
+                text: text.to_string(),
+                size_q4: (font_size_px.max(0.0) * 4.0).round() as u16,
+                bold,
+                italic,
+            };
+            let mut inner = self.inner.borrow_mut();
+            if let Some(layout) = inner.cache.get(&key) {
+                return Some(layout.clone());
+            }
+            let layout = compute_layout(&inner.factory, &inner.families, &key)?;
+            inner.cache.insert(key, layout.clone());
+            Some(layout)
+        }
+        #[cfg(not(windows))]
+        {
+            let _ = (font, text, font_size_px, bold, italic);
+            None
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn compute_layout(
+    factory: &windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: &UiFontFamilies,
+    key: &LayoutKey,
+) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+    use windows::core::PCWSTR;
+    use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+        DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL,
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR, DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS,
+        DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS, DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP,
+    };
+
+    let family = match key.font {
+        UiFontKind::Sans => &families.sans,
+        UiFontKind::Serif => &families.serif,
+    };
+    let family_wide = wide(family);
+    let locale = wide("en-US");
+    let utf16: Vec<u16> = key.text.encode_utf16().collect();
+
+    let weight = if key.bold {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR
+    };
+    let style = if key.italic {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL
+    };
+    let font_size_px = key.size_q4 as f32 / 4.0;
+
+    let format = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextFormat(
+                PCWSTR(family_wide.as_ptr()),
+                None,
+                weight,
+                style,
+                DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL,
+                font_size_px,
+                PCWSTR(locale.as_ptr()),
+            )
+            .ok()?
+    };
+    let _ = unsafe { format.SetWordWrapping(DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP) };
+
+    let layout = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextLayout(&utf16, &format, 4096.0, 4096.0)
+            .ok()?
+    };
+
+    let mut metrics = DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS::default();
+    unsafe { layout.GetMetrics(&mut metrics).ok()? };
+
+    let mut glyph_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(key.text.chars().count());
+    let mut utf16_index = 0u32;
+    for ch in key.text.chars() {
+        let mut x = 0.0f32;
+        let mut y = 0.0f32;
+        let mut hit = DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS::default();
+        unsafe {
+            layout
+                .HitTestTextPosition(utf16_index, false, &mut x, &mut y, &mut hit)
+                .ok()?;
+        }
+        glyph_offsets.push(x);
+        utf16_index += ch.len_utf16() as u32;
+    }
+
+    Some(UiTextLayout {
+        width: metrics.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace.max(metrics.width),
+        line_height: metrics.height.max(font_size_px),
+        glyph_offsets,
+    })
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn wide(value: &str) -> Vec<u16> {
+    value.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect()
+}

+## Changes in Iteration 80
+
+1. **Real DirectWrite UI text layout path** ÔÇö Added [`ui/text_layout.rs`] to cache DirectWrite measurements for sans and serif UI runs. `UiTextRenderer` now queries that engine for widths and per-glyph x offsets instead of relying on `ui_char_advances`, average-advance estimates, or manual truncation math.

+struct UiFontBundle {
+    family: String,
+    rasterizer: Box<dyn godly_terminal_surface::glyph_rasterizer::GlyphRasterizer>,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_font_bundle(candidates: &[&str], label: &str) -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    use godly_terminal_surface::directwrite_rasterizer::DirectWriteRasterizer;
+
+    for family in candidates {
+        let mut dw = DirectWriteRasterizer::new().ok()?;
+        if dw.load_system_font(family).is_ok() {
+            log::info!("[FONT] {label}: {family}");
+            return Some(UiFontBundle {
+                family: (*family).to_string(),
+                rasterizer: Box::new(dw),
+            });
+        }
+    }
+    log::warn!("[FONT] No {label} font available from candidates: {}", candidates.join(", "));
+    None
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_sans_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {

+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_serif_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {

+    fn layout_text(
+        &self,
+        font_kind: UiFontKind,
+        s: &str,
+        scale: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> UiTextLayout {
+        if let Some(engine) = &self.layout_engine {
+            if let Some(layout) =
+                engine.layout(font_kind, s, self.font_size_px * scale, bold, italic)
+            {
+                return layout;
+            }
+        }
+
+        let advance = if self.ui_avg_advance > 0.0 {
+            self.ui_avg_advance * scale
+        } else {
+            self.cell_width * 0.75 * scale
+        };
+        let mut glyph_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(s.chars().count());
+        let mut x = 0.0;
+        for _ in s.chars() {
+            glyph_offsets.push(x);
+            x += advance;
+        }
+        UiTextLayout {
+            width: x,
+            line_height: self.font_size_px * scale,
+            glyph_offsets,
+        }
+    }
