+use std::cell::RefCell;
+use std::collections::HashMap;
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+pub enum UiFontKind {
+    Sans,
+    Serif,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiTextLayout {
+    pub width: f32,
+    pub line_height: f32,
+    pub glyph_offsets: Vec<f32>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiFontFamilies {
+    pub sans: String,
+    pub serif: String,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+struct LayoutKey {
+    font: UiFontKind,
+    text: String,
+    size_q4: u16,
+    bold: bool,
+    italic: bool,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+struct LayoutCache {
+    factory: windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: UiFontFamilies,
+    cache: HashMap<LayoutKey, UiTextLayout>,
+}
+
+pub struct UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    inner: RefCell<LayoutCache>,
+}
+
+impl UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    pub fn new(families: UiFontFamilies) -> windows::core::Result<Self> {
+        use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+            DWriteCreateFactory, DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED, IDWriteFactory,
+        };
+
+        let factory: IDWriteFactory = unsafe { DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED)? };
+        Ok(Self {
+            inner: RefCell::new(LayoutCache {
+                factory,
+                families,
+                cache: HashMap::new(),
+            }),
+        })
+    }
+
+    #[cfg(not(windows))]
+    pub fn new(_families: UiFontFamilies) -> Result<Self, ()> {
+        Ok(Self {})
+    }
+
+    pub fn layout(
+        &self,
+        font: UiFontKind,
+        text: &str,
+        font_size_px: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+        #[cfg(windows)]
+        {
+            let key = LayoutKey {
+                font,
+                text: text.to_string(),
+                size_q4: (font_size_px.max(0.0) * 4.0).round() as u16,
+                bold,
+                italic,
+            };
+            let mut inner = self.inner.borrow_mut();
+            if let Some(layout) = inner.cache.get(&key) {
+                return Some(layout.clone());
+            }
+            let layout = compute_layout(&inner.factory, &inner.families, &key)?;
+            inner.cache.insert(key, layout.clone());
+            Some(layout)
+        }
+        #[cfg(not(windows))]
+        {
+            let _ = (font, text, font_size_px, bold, italic);
+            None
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn compute_layout(
+    factory: &windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: &UiFontFamilies,
+    key: &LayoutKey,
+) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+    use windows::core::PCWSTR;
+    use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+        DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL,
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR, DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS,
+        DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS, DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP,
+    };
+
+    let family = match key.font {
+        UiFontKind::Sans => &families.sans,
+        UiFontKind::Serif => &families.serif,
+    };
+    let family_wide = wide(family);
+    let locale = wide("en-US");
+    let utf16: Vec<u16> = key.text.encode_utf16().collect();
+
+    let weight = if key.bold {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR
+    };
+    let style = if key.italic {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL
+    };
+    let font_size_px = key.size_q4 as f32 / 4.0;
+
+    let format = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextFormat(
+                PCWSTR(family_wide.as_ptr()),
+                None,
+                weight,
+                style,
+                DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL,
+                font_size_px,
+                PCWSTR(locale.as_ptr()),
+            )
+            .ok()?
+    };
+    let _ = unsafe { format.SetWordWrapping(DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP) };
+
+    let layout = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextLayout(&utf16, &format, 4096.0, 4096.0)
+            .ok()?
+    };
+
+    let mut metrics = DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS::default();
+    unsafe { layout.GetMetrics(&mut metrics).ok()? };
+
+    let mut glyph_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(key.text.chars().count());
+    let mut utf16_index = 0u32;
+    for ch in key.text.chars() {
+        let mut x = 0.0f32;
+        let mut y = 0.0f32;
+        let mut hit = DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS::default();
+        unsafe {
+            layout
+                .HitTestTextPosition(utf16_index, false, &mut x, &mut y, &mut hit)
+                .ok()?;
+        }
+        glyph_offsets.push(x);
+        utf16_index += ch.len_utf16() as u32;
+    }
+
+    Some(UiTextLayout {
+        width: metrics.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace.max(metrics.width),
+        line_height: metrics.height.max(font_size_px),
+        glyph_offsets,
+    })
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn wide(value: &str) -> Vec<u16> {
+    value.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect()
+}

+    }
+}

+struct UiFontBundle {
+    family: String,
+    rasterizer: Box<dyn godly_terminal_surface::glyph_rasterizer::GlyphRasterizer>,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_font_bundle(candidates: &[&str], label: &str) -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    use godly_terminal_surface::directwrite_rasterizer::DirectWriteRasterizer;
+
+    for family in candidates {
+        let mut dw = DirectWriteRasterizer::new().ok()?;
+        if dw.load_system_font(family).is_ok() {
+            log::info!("[FONT] {label}: {family}");
+            return Some(UiFontBundle {
+                family: (*family).to_string(),
+                rasterizer: Box::new(dw),
+            });
+        }
+    }
+    log::warn!("[FONT] No {label} font available from candidates: {}", candidates.join(", "));
+    None
+}
+

+        &self,
+        font_kind: UiFontKind,
+        s: &str,
+        scale: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> UiTextLayout {
+        if let Some(engine) = &self.layout_engine {
+            if let Some(layout) =
+                engine.layout(font_kind, s, self.font_size_px * scale, bold, italic)

+                return layout;

+        }

+            width: x,

+            glyph_offsets,
+        }

+use std::cell::RefCell;
+use std::collections::HashMap;
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+pub enum UiFontKind {
+    Sans,
+    Serif,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiTextLayout {
+    pub width: f32,
+    pub line_height: f32,
+    pub glyph_offsets: Vec<f32>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiFontFamilies {
+    pub sans: String,
+    pub serif: String,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+struct LayoutKey {
+    font: UiFontKind,
+    text: String,
+    size_q4: u16,
+    bold: bool,
+    italic: bool,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+struct LayoutCache {
+    factory: windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: UiFontFamilies,
+    cache: HashMap<LayoutKey, UiTextLayout>,
+}
+
+pub struct UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    inner: RefCell<LayoutCache>,
+}
+
+impl UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    pub fn new(families: UiFontFamilies) -> windows::core::Result<Self> {
+        use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+            DWriteCreateFactory, DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED, IDWriteFactory,
+        };
+
+        let factory: IDWriteFactory = unsafe { DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED)? };
+        Ok(Self {
+            inner: RefCell::new(LayoutCache {
+                factory,
+                families,
+                cache: HashMap::new(),
+            }),
+        })
+    }
+
+    #[cfg(not(windows))]
+    pub fn new(_families: UiFontFamilies) -> Result<Self, ()> {
+        Ok(Self {})
+    }
+
+    pub fn layout(
+        &self,
+        font: UiFontKind,
+        text: &str,
+        font_size_px: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+        #[cfg(windows)]
+        {
+            let key = LayoutKey {
+                font,
+                text: text.to_string(),
+                size_q4: (font_size_px.max(0.0) * 4.0).round() as u16,
+                bold,
+                italic,
+            };
+            let mut inner = self.inner.borrow_mut();
+            if let Some(layout) = inner.cache.get(&key) {
+                return Some(layout.clone());
+            }
+            let layout = compute_layout(&inner.factory, &inner.families, &key)?;
+            inner.cache.insert(key, layout.clone());
+            Some(layout)
+        }
+        #[cfg(not(windows))]
+        {
+            let _ = (font, text, font_size_px, bold, italic);
+            None
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn compute_layout(
+    factory: &windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: &UiFontFamilies,
+    key: &LayoutKey,
+) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+    use windows::core::PCWSTR;
+    use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+        DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL,
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR, DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS,
+        DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS, DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP,
+    };
+
+    let family = match key.font {
+        UiFontKind::Sans => &families.sans,
+        UiFontKind::Serif => &families.serif,
+    };
+    let family_wide = wide(family);
+    let locale = wide("en-US");
+    let utf16: Vec<u16> = key.text.encode_utf16().collect();
+
+    let weight = if key.bold {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR
+    };
+    let style = if key.italic {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL
+    };
+    let font_size_px = key.size_q4 as f32 / 4.0;
+
+    let format = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextFormat(
+                PCWSTR(family_wide.as_ptr()),
+                None,
+                weight,
+                style,
+                DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL,
+                font_size_px,
+                PCWSTR(locale.as_ptr()),
+            )
+            .ok()?
+    };
+    let _ = unsafe { format.SetWordWrapping(DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP) };
+
+    let layout = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextLayout(&utf16, &format, 4096.0, 4096.0)
+            .ok()?
+    };
+
+    let mut metrics = DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS::default();
+    unsafe { layout.GetMetrics(&mut metrics).ok()? };
+
+    let mut glyph_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(key.text.chars().count());
+    let mut utf16_index = 0u32;
+    for ch in key.text.chars() {
+        let mut x = 0.0f32;
+        let mut y = 0.0f32;
+        let mut hit = DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS::default();
+        unsafe {
+            layout
+                .HitTestTextPosition(utf16_index, false, &mut x, &mut y, &mut hit)
+                .ok()?;
+        }
+        glyph_offsets.push(x);
+        utf16_index += ch.len_utf16() as u32;
+    }
+
+    Some(UiTextLayout {
+        width: metrics.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace.max(metrics.width),
+        line_height: metrics.height.max(font_size_px),
+        glyph_offsets,
+    })
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn wide(value: &str) -> Vec<u16> {
+    value.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect()
+}

+    }
+
+    pub fn new_ui_serif(ch: char, font_size: f32, bold: bool, italic: bool) -> Self {
+        Self::new_font(ch, font_size, bold, italic, 2)
+    }
+}

+## Changes in Iteration 80
+
+1. **Real DirectWrite UI text layout path** ÔÇö Added [`ui/text_layout.rs`] to cache DirectWrite measurements for sans and serif UI runs. `UiTextRenderer` now queries that engine for widths and per-glyph x offsets instead of relying on `ui_char_advances`, average-advance estimates, or manual truncation math.

+struct UiFontBundle {
+    family: String,
+    rasterizer: Box<dyn godly_terminal_surface::glyph_rasterizer::GlyphRasterizer>,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_font_bundle(candidates: &[&str], label: &str) -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    use godly_terminal_surface::directwrite_rasterizer::DirectWriteRasterizer;
+
+    for family in candidates {
+        let mut dw = DirectWriteRasterizer::new().ok()?;
+        if dw.load_system_font(family).is_ok() {
+            log::info!("[FONT] {label}: {family}");
+            return Some(UiFontBundle {
+                family: (*family).to_string(),
+                rasterizer: Box::new(dw),
+            });
+        }
+    }
+    log::warn!("[FONT] No {label} font available from candidates: {}", candidates.join(", "));
+    None
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_sans_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    create_ui_font_bundle(&["Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI"], "UI sans font")
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_serif_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    create_ui_font_bundle(&["Georgia", "Cambria", "Times New Roman"], "UI serif font")
+}
+
+#[cfg(not(windows))]
+fn create_ui_sans_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    None

+#[cfg(not(windows))]
+fn create_ui_serif_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {

+use std::cell::RefCell;
+use std::collections::HashMap;
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+pub enum UiFontKind {
+    Sans,
+    Serif,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiTextLayout {
+    pub width: f32,
+    pub line_height: f32,
+    pub glyph_offsets: Vec<f32>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiFontFamilies {
+    pub sans: String,
+    pub serif: String,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+struct LayoutKey {
+    font: UiFontKind,
+    text: String,
+    size_q4: u16,
+    bold: bool,
+    italic: bool,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+struct LayoutCache {
+    factory: windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: UiFontFamilies,
+    cache: HashMap<LayoutKey, UiTextLayout>,
+}
+
+pub struct UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    inner: RefCell<LayoutCache>,
+}
+
+impl UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    pub fn new(families: UiFontFamilies) -> windows::core::Result<Self> {
+        use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+            DWriteCreateFactory, DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED, IDWriteFactory,
+        };
+
+        let factory: IDWriteFactory = unsafe { DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED)? };
+        Ok(Self {
+            inner: RefCell::new(LayoutCache {
+                factory,
+                families,
+                cache: HashMap::new(),
+            }),
+        })
+    }
+
+    #[cfg(not(windows))]
+    pub fn new(_families: UiFontFamilies) -> Result<Self, ()> {
+        Ok(Self {})
+    }
+
+    pub fn layout(
+        &self,
+        font: UiFontKind,
+        text: &str,
+        font_size_px: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+        #[cfg(windows)]
+        {
+            let key = LayoutKey {
+                font,
+                text: text.to_string(),
+                size_q4: (font_size_px.max(0.0) * 4.0).round() as u16,
+                bold,
+                italic,
+            };
+            let mut inner = self.inner.borrow_mut();
+            if let Some(layout) = inner.cache.get(&key) {
+                return Some(layout.clone());
+            }
+            let layout = compute_layout(&inner.factory, &inner.families, &key)?;
+            inner.cache.insert(key, layout.clone());
+            Some(layout)
+        }
+        #[cfg(not(windows))]
+        {
+            let _ = (font, text, font_size_px, bold, italic);
+            None
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn compute_layout(
+    factory: &windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: &UiFontFamilies,
+    key: &LayoutKey,
+) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+    use windows::core::PCWSTR;
+    use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+        DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL,
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR, DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS,
+        DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS, DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP,
+    };
+
+    let family = match key.font {
+        UiFontKind::Sans => &families.sans,
+        UiFontKind::Serif => &families.serif,
+    };
+    let family_wide = wide(family);
+    let locale = wide("en-US");
+    let utf16: Vec<u16> = key.text.encode_utf16().collect();
+
+    let weight = if key.bold {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR
+    };
+    let style = if key.italic {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL
+    };
+    let font_size_px = key.size_q4 as f32 / 4.0;
+
+    let format = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextFormat(
+                PCWSTR(family_wide.as_ptr()),
+                None,
+                weight,
+                style,
+                DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL,
+                font_size_px,
+                PCWSTR(locale.as_ptr()),
+            )
+            .ok()?
+    };
+    let _ = unsafe { format.SetWordWrapping(DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP) };
+
+    let layout = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextLayout(&utf16, &format, 4096.0, 4096.0)
+            .ok()?
+    };
+
+    let mut metrics = DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS::default();
+    unsafe { layout.GetMetrics(&mut metrics).ok()? };
+
+    let mut glyph_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(key.text.chars().count());
+    let mut utf16_index = 0u32;
+    for ch in key.text.chars() {
+        let mut x = 0.0f32;
+        let mut y = 0.0f32;
+        let mut hit = DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS::default();
+        unsafe {
+            layout
+                .HitTestTextPosition(utf16_index, false, &mut x, &mut y, &mut hit)
+                .ok()?;
+        }
+        glyph_offsets.push(x);
+        utf16_index += ch.len_utf16() as u32;
+    }
+
+    Some(UiTextLayout {
+        width: metrics.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace.max(metrics.width),
+        line_height: metrics.height.max(font_size_px),
+        glyph_offsets,
+    })
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn wide(value: &str) -> Vec<u16> {
+    value.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect()
+}

+            font_id,
+        }
+    }
+

+    pub fn new_ui(ch: char, font_size: f32, bold: bool) -> Self {
+        Self::new_font(ch, font_size, bold, false, 1)
+    }
+
+    pub fn new_ui_serif(ch: char, font_size: f32, bold: bool, italic: bool) -> Self {
+        Self::new_font(ch, font_size, bold, italic, 2)
+    }
+}

 Target: Match Windows Terminal / Zed quality (pixel-perfect, crisp text)
 
+## Iteration 80 ÔÇö DirectWrite UI Layout + Background-Aware Compositing
+
+**Goal**: Replace the remaining faux chrome-text path with a real Windows
+measurement/compositing path instead of spending another loop on spacing polish.
+
+**Changes made**:
+
+1. **DirectWrite UI layout cache** (`ui/text_layout.rs`, `ui/builder.rs`) ÔÇö
+   Added a cached DirectWrite text layout engine for sans and serif UI runs.
+   `UiTextRenderer` now asks that engine for widths and per-glyph x offsets,
+   replacing the old `ui_char_advances` / average-advance fallback path for
+   real UI text measurement and placement.
+
+2. **Real font roles and italics** (`ui/builder.rs`, `terminal_renderer.rs`,
+   `ui/right_panel.rs`) ÔÇö `TextCommand` now carries a real font role
+   (`terminal`, `ui sans`, `ui serif`) plus italic state. The renderer picks
+   the matching rasterizer, and the poem panel now renders through a real
+   serif italic face instead of synthetic skew.
+
+3. **Background-aware compositing** (`ui/builder.rs`, `terminal_renderer.rs`,
+   `main.rs`) ÔÇö Text commands now choose between flat-background subpixel
+   blending and mixed-background grayscale AA. Flat chrome surfaces (status
+   bar, sidebar, tabs, right panel chrome) can use ClearType-style subpixel
+   blending, while mixed surfaces such as the welcome hero and breadcrumb
+   explicitly opt into grayscale AA.
+
+4. **Screenshot helper improved for real shell capture**

+struct UiFontBundle {

+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_font_bundle(candidates: &[&str], label: &str) -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    use godly_terminal_surface::directwrite_rasterizer::DirectWriteRasterizer;
+
+    for family in candidates {
+        let mut dw = DirectWriteRasterizer::new().ok()?;
+        if dw.load_system_font(family).is_ok() {
+            log::info!("[FONT] {label}: {family}");
+            return Some(UiFontBundle {
+                family: (*family).to_string(),
+                rasterizer: Box::new(dw),
+            });
+        }
+    }
+    log::warn!("[FONT] No {label} font available from candidates: {}", candidates.join(", "));
+    None
+}

+    pub fn text_width_serif_scaled(
+        &self,
+        s: &str,
+        scale: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> f32 {
+        self.layout_text(UiFontKind::Serif, s, scale, bold, italic)
+            .width
+    }
+
+    pub fn glyph_offsets_ui(
+        &self,
+        s: &str,
+        scale: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+        font_kind: TextFontKind,
+    ) -> Vec<f32> {
+        match font_kind {
+            TextFontKind::TerminalMono => Vec::new(),
+            TextFontKind::UiSans => self
+                .layout_text(UiFontKind::Sans, s, scale, bold, italic)
+                .glyph_offsets,
+            TextFontKind::UiSerif => self
+                .layout_text(UiFontKind::Serif, s, scale, bold, italic)
+                .glyph_offsets,
+        }
+    }
+
+    fn layout_text(
+        &self,
+        font_kind: UiFontKind,
+        s: &str,
+        scale: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> UiTextLayout {
+        if let Some(engine) = &self.layout_engine {
+            if let Some(layout) =
+                engine.layout(font_kind, s, self.font_size_px * scale, bold, italic)
+            {
+                return layout;
+            }
+        }
+
+        let advance = if self.ui_avg_advance > 0.0 {
+            self.ui_avg_advance * scale
+        } else {
+            self.cell_width * 0.75 * scale
+        };
+        let mut glyph_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(s.chars().count());
+        let mut x = 0.0;
+        for _ in s.chars() {
+            glyph_offsets.push(x);
+            x += advance;
+        }
+        UiTextLayout {
+            width: x,
+            line_height: self.font_size_px * scale,
+            glyph_offsets,
+        }
+    }
+}

+use std::cell::RefCell;
+use std::collections::HashMap;
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+pub enum UiFontKind {
+    Sans,
+    Serif,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiTextLayout {
+    pub width: f32,
+    pub line_height: f32,
+    pub glyph_offsets: Vec<f32>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiFontFamilies {
+    pub sans: String,
+    pub serif: String,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+struct LayoutKey {
+    font: UiFontKind,
+    text: String,
+    size_q4: u16,
+    bold: bool,
+    italic: bool,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+struct LayoutCache {
+    factory: windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: UiFontFamilies,
+    cache: HashMap<LayoutKey, UiTextLayout>,
+}
+
+pub struct UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    inner: RefCell<LayoutCache>,
+}
+
+impl UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    pub fn new(families: UiFontFamilies) -> windows::core::Result<Self> {
+        use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+            DWriteCreateFactory, DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED, IDWriteFactory,
+        };
+
+        let factory: IDWriteFactory = unsafe { DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED)? };
+        Ok(Self {
+            inner: RefCell::new(LayoutCache {
+                factory,
+                families,
+                cache: HashMap::new(),
+            }),
+        })
+    }
+
+    #[cfg(not(windows))]
+    pub fn new(_families: UiFontFamilies) -> Result<Self, ()> {
+        Ok(Self {})
+    }
+
+    pub fn layout(
+        &self,
+        font: UiFontKind,
+        text: &str,
+        font_size_px: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+        #[cfg(windows)]
+        {
+            let key = LayoutKey {
+                font,
+                text: text.to_string(),
+                size_q4: (font_size_px.max(0.0) * 4.0).round() as u16,
+                bold,
+                italic,
+            };
+            let mut inner = self.inner.borrow_mut();
+            if let Some(layout) = inner.cache.get(&key) {
+                return Some(layout.clone());
+            }
+            let layout = compute_layout(&inner.factory, &inner.families, &key)?;
+            inner.cache.insert(key, layout.clone());
+            Some(layout)
+        }
+        #[cfg(not(windows))]
+        {
+            let _ = (font, text, font_size_px, bold, italic);
+            None
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn compute_layout(
+    factory: &windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: &UiFontFamilies,
+    key: &LayoutKey,
+) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+    use windows::core::PCWSTR;
+    use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+        DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL,
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR, DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS,
+        DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS, DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP,
+    };
+
+    let family = match key.font {
+        UiFontKind::Sans => &families.sans,
+        UiFontKind::Serif => &families.serif,
+    };
+    let family_wide = wide(family);
+    let locale = wide("en-US");
+    let utf16: Vec<u16> = key.text.encode_utf16().collect();
+
+    let weight = if key.bold {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR
+    };
+    let style = if key.italic {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL
+    };
+    let font_size_px = key.size_q4 as f32 / 4.0;
+
+    let format = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextFormat(
+                PCWSTR(family_wide.as_ptr()),
+                None,
+                weight,
+                style,
+                DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL,
+                font_size_px,
+                PCWSTR(locale.as_ptr()),
+            )
+            .ok()?
+    };
+    let _ = unsafe { format.SetWordWrapping(DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP) };
+
+    let layout = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextLayout(&utf16, &format, 4096.0, 4096.0)
+            .ok()?
+    };
+
+    let mut metrics = DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS::default();
+    unsafe { layout.GetMetrics(&mut metrics).ok()? };
+
+    let mut glyph_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(key.text.chars().count());
+    let mut utf16_index = 0u32;
+    for ch in key.text.chars() {
+        let mut x = 0.0f32;
+        let mut y = 0.0f32;
+        let mut hit = DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS::default();
+        unsafe {
+            layout
+                .HitTestTextPosition(utf16_index, false, &mut x, &mut y, &mut hit)
+                .ok()?;
+        }
+        glyph_offsets.push(x);
+        utf16_index += ch.len_utf16() as u32;
+    }
+
+    Some(UiTextLayout {
+        width: metrics.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace.max(metrics.width),
+        line_height: metrics.height.max(font_size_px),
+        glyph_offsets,
+    })
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn wide(value: &str) -> Vec<u16> {
+    value.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect()
+}

+struct UiFontBundle {
+    family: String,
+    rasterizer: Box<dyn godly_terminal_surface::glyph_rasterizer::GlyphRasterizer>,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_font_bundle(candidates: &[&str], label: &str) -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    use godly_terminal_surface::directwrite_rasterizer::DirectWriteRasterizer;
+
+    for family in candidates {
+        let mut dw = DirectWriteRasterizer::new().ok()?;
+        if dw.load_system_font(family).is_ok() {
+            log::info!("[FONT] {label}: {family}");
+            return Some(UiFontBundle {
+                family: (*family).to_string(),
+                rasterizer: Box::new(dw),
+            });
+        }
+    }
+    log::warn!("[FONT] No {label} font available from candidates: {}", candidates.join(", "));
+    None
+}
+

+    fn layout_text(
+        &self,
+        font_kind: UiFontKind,
+        s: &str,
+        scale: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> UiTextLayout {
+        if let Some(engine) = &self.layout_engine {
+            if let Some(layout) =
+                engine.layout(font_kind, s, self.font_size_px * scale, bold, italic)
+            {
+                return layout;
+            }
+        }
+
+        let advance = if self.ui_avg_advance > 0.0 {
+            self.ui_avg_advance * scale
+        } else {
+            self.cell_width * 0.75 * scale
+        };
+        let mut glyph_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(s.chars().count());
+        let mut x = 0.0;
+        for _ in s.chars() {
+            glyph_offsets.push(x);
+            x += advance;
+        }
+        UiTextLayout {
+            width: x,
+            line_height: self.font_size_px * scale,
+            glyph_offsets,
+        }
+    }

+use std::cell::RefCell;
+use std::collections::HashMap;
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+pub enum UiFontKind {
+    Sans,
+    Serif,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiTextLayout {
+    pub width: f32,
+    pub line_height: f32,
+    pub glyph_offsets: Vec<f32>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiFontFamilies {
+    pub sans: String,
+    pub serif: String,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+struct LayoutKey {
+    font: UiFontKind,
+    text: String,
+    size_q4: u16,
+    bold: bool,
+    italic: bool,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+struct LayoutCache {
+    factory: windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: UiFontFamilies,
+    cache: HashMap<LayoutKey, UiTextLayout>,
+}
+
+pub struct UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    inner: RefCell<LayoutCache>,
+}
+
+impl UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    pub fn new(families: UiFontFamilies) -> windows::core::Result<Self> {
+        use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+            DWriteCreateFactory, DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED, IDWriteFactory,
+        };
+
+        let factory: IDWriteFactory = unsafe { DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED)? };
+        Ok(Self {
+            inner: RefCell::new(LayoutCache {
+                factory,
+                families,
+                cache: HashMap::new(),
+            }),
+        })
+    }
+
+    #[cfg(not(windows))]
+    pub fn new(_families: UiFontFamilies) -> Result<Self, ()> {
+        Ok(Self {})
+    }
+
+    pub fn layout(
+        &self,
+        font: UiFontKind,
+        text: &str,
+        font_size_px: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+        #[cfg(windows)]
+        {
+            let key = LayoutKey {
+                font,
+                text: text.to_string(),
+                size_q4: (font_size_px.max(0.0) * 4.0).round() as u16,
+                bold,
+                italic,
+            };
+            let mut inner = self.inner.borrow_mut();
+            if let Some(layout) = inner.cache.get(&key) {
+                return Some(layout.clone());
+            }
+            let layout = compute_layout(&inner.factory, &inner.families, &key)?;
+            inner.cache.insert(key, layout.clone());
+            Some(layout)
+        }
+        #[cfg(not(windows))]
+        {
+            let _ = (font, text, font_size_px, bold, italic);
+            None
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn compute_layout(
+    factory: &windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: &UiFontFamilies,
+    key: &LayoutKey,
+) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+    use windows::core::PCWSTR;
+    use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+        DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL,
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR, DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS,
+        DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS, DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP,
+    };
+
+    let family = match key.font {
+        UiFontKind::Sans => &families.sans,
+        UiFontKind::Serif => &families.serif,
+    };
+    let family_wide = wide(family);
+    let locale = wide("en-US");
+    let utf16: Vec<u16> = key.text.encode_utf16().collect();
+
+    let weight = if key.bold {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR
+    };
+    let style = if key.italic {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL
+    };
+    let font_size_px = key.size_q4 as f32 / 4.0;
+
+    let format = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextFormat(
+                PCWSTR(family_wide.as_ptr()),
+                None,
+                weight,
+                style,
+                DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL,
+                font_size_px,
+                PCWSTR(locale.as_ptr()),
+            )
+            .ok()?
+    };
+    let _ = unsafe { format.SetWordWrapping(DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP) };
+
+    let layout = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextLayout(&utf16, &format, 4096.0, 4096.0)
+            .ok()?
+    };
+
+    let mut metrics = DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS::default();
+    unsafe { layout.GetMetrics(&mut metrics).ok()? };
+
+    let mut glyph_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(key.text.chars().count());
+    let mut utf16_index = 0u32;
+    for ch in key.text.chars() {
+        let mut x = 0.0f32;
+        let mut y = 0.0f32;
+        let mut hit = DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS::default();
+        unsafe {
+            layout
+                .HitTestTextPosition(utf16_index, false, &mut x, &mut y, &mut hit)
+                .ok()?;
+        }
+        glyph_offsets.push(x);
+        utf16_index += ch.len_utf16() as u32;
+    }
+
+    Some(UiTextLayout {
+        width: metrics.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace.max(metrics.width),
+        line_height: metrics.height.max(font_size_px),
+        glyph_offsets,
+    })
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn wide(value: &str) -> Vec<u16> {
+    value.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect()
+}

+
+    pub fn new_ui_serif(ch: char, font_size: f32, bold: bool, italic: bool) -> Self {
+        Self::new_font(ch, font_size, bold, italic, 2)
+    }
+}

+fn create_ui_font_bundle(candidates: &[&str], label: &str) -> Option<UiFontBundle> {

+            log::info!("[FONT] {label}: {family}");
+            return Some(UiFontBundle {
+                family: (*family).to_string(),
+                rasterizer: Box::new(dw),
+            });
+        }
+    }
+    log::warn!("[FONT] No {label} font available from candidates: {}", candidates.join(", "));
+    None
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_sans_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    create_ui_font_bundle(&["Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI"], "UI sans font")
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_serif_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    create_ui_font_bundle(&["Georgia", "Cambria", "Times New Roman"], "UI serif font")
+}
+
+#[cfg(not(windows))]
+fn create_ui_sans_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    None
+}
+
+#[cfg(not(windows))]
+fn create_ui_serif_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    None
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_text_layout_engine(
+    families: ui::text_layout::UiFontFamilies,

+    ui::text_layout::UiTextLayoutEngine::new(families).ok()
+}

+#[cfg(not(windows))]
+fn create_ui_text_layout_engine(
+    _families: ui::text_layout::UiFontFamilies,
+) -> Option<ui::text_layout::UiTextLayoutEngine> {
+    None

+use std::cell::RefCell;
+use std::collections::HashMap;
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+pub enum UiFontKind {
+    Sans,
+    Serif,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiTextLayout {
+    pub width: f32,
+    pub line_height: f32,
+    pub glyph_offsets: Vec<f32>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiFontFamilies {
+    pub sans: String,
+    pub serif: String,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+struct LayoutKey {
+    font: UiFontKind,
+    text: String,
+    size_q4: u16,
+    bold: bool,
+    italic: bool,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+struct LayoutCache {
+    factory: windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: UiFontFamilies,
+    cache: HashMap<LayoutKey, UiTextLayout>,
+}
+
+pub struct UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    inner: RefCell<LayoutCache>,
+}
+
+impl UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    pub fn new(families: UiFontFamilies) -> windows::core::Result<Self> {
+        use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+            DWriteCreateFactory, DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED, IDWriteFactory,
+        };
+
+        let factory: IDWriteFactory = unsafe { DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED)? };
+        Ok(Self {
+            inner: RefCell::new(LayoutCache {
+                factory,
+                families,
+                cache: HashMap::new(),
+            }),
+        })
+    }
+
+    #[cfg(not(windows))]
+    pub fn new(_families: UiFontFamilies) -> Result<Self, ()> {
+        Ok(Self {})
+    }
+
+    pub fn layout(
+        &self,
+        font: UiFontKind,
+        text: &str,
+        font_size_px: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+        #[cfg(windows)]
+        {
+            let key = LayoutKey {
+                font,
+                text: text.to_string(),
+                size_q4: (font_size_px.max(0.0) * 4.0).round() as u16,
+                bold,
+                italic,
+            };
+            let mut inner = self.inner.borrow_mut();
+            if let Some(layout) = inner.cache.get(&key) {
+                return Some(layout.clone());
+            }
+            let layout = compute_layout(&inner.factory, &inner.families, &key)?;
+            inner.cache.insert(key, layout.clone());
+            Some(layout)
+        }
+        #[cfg(not(windows))]
+        {
+            let _ = (font, text, font_size_px, bold, italic);
+            None
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn compute_layout(
+    factory: &windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: &UiFontFamilies,
+    key: &LayoutKey,
+) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+    use windows::core::PCWSTR;
+    use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+        DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL,
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR, DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS,
+        DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS, DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP,
+    };
+
+    let family = match key.font {
+        UiFontKind::Sans => &families.sans,
+        UiFontKind::Serif => &families.serif,
+    };
+    let family_wide = wide(family);
+    let locale = wide("en-US");
+    let utf16: Vec<u16> = key.text.encode_utf16().collect();
+
+    let weight = if key.bold {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR
+    };
+    let style = if key.italic {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL
+    };
+    let font_size_px = key.size_q4 as f32 / 4.0;
+
+    let format = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextFormat(
+                PCWSTR(family_wide.as_ptr()),
+                None,
+                weight,
+                style,
+                DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL,
+                font_size_px,
+                PCWSTR(locale.as_ptr()),
+            )
+            .ok()?
+    };
+    let _ = unsafe { format.SetWordWrapping(DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP) };
+
+    let layout = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextLayout(&utf16, &format, 4096.0, 4096.0)
+            .ok()?
+    };
+
+    let mut metrics = DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS::default();
+    unsafe { layout.GetMetrics(&mut metrics).ok()? };
+
+    let mut glyph_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(key.text.chars().count());
+    let mut utf16_index = 0u32;
+    for ch in key.text.chars() {
+        let mut x = 0.0f32;
+        let mut y = 0.0f32;
+        let mut hit = DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS::default();
+        unsafe {
+            layout
+                .HitTestTextPosition(utf16_index, false, &mut x, &mut y, &mut hit)
+                .ok()?;
+        }
+        glyph_offsets.push(x);
+        utf16_index += ch.len_utf16() as u32;
+    }
+
+    Some(UiTextLayout {
+        width: metrics.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace.max(metrics.width),
+        line_height: metrics.height.max(font_size_px),
+        glyph_offsets,
+    })
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn wide(value: &str) -> Vec<u16> {
+    value.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect()
+}

+        Self {
+            codepoint: ch,
+            size_q4: (font_size * 4.0) as u16,
+            bold,
+            italic,
+            font_id,
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// Create a key for UI font glyphs (proportional sans-serif).
+    pub fn new_ui(ch: char, font_size: f32, bold: bool) -> Self {
+        Self::new_font(ch, font_size, bold, false, 1)
+    }
+
+    pub fn new_ui_serif(ch: char, font_size: f32, bold: bool, italic: bool) -> Self {
+        Self::new_font(ch, font_size, bold, italic, 2)
+    }
+}

+struct UiFontBundle {
+    family: String,
+    rasterizer: Box<dyn godly_terminal_surface::glyph_rasterizer::GlyphRasterizer>,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_font_bundle(candidates: &[&str], label: &str) -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    use godly_terminal_surface::directwrite_rasterizer::DirectWriteRasterizer;
+
+    for family in candidates {
+        let mut dw = DirectWriteRasterizer::new().ok()?;
+        if dw.load_system_font(family).is_ok() {
+            log::info!("[FONT] {label}: {family}");
+            return Some(UiFontBundle {
+                family: (*family).to_string(),
+                rasterizer: Box::new(dw),
+            });
+        }
+    }
+    log::warn!("[FONT] No {label} font available from candidates: {}", candidates.join(", "));
+    None
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_sans_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    create_ui_font_bundle(&["Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI"], "UI sans font")

+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_serif_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {

+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> f32 {
+        self.layout_text(UiFontKind::Serif, s, scale, bold, italic)
+            .width

+
+    pub fn glyph_offsets_ui(
+        &self,
+        s: &str,
+        scale: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+        font_kind: TextFontKind,
+    ) -> Vec<f32> {
+        match font_kind {
+            TextFontKind::TerminalMono => Vec::new(),
+            TextFontKind::UiSans => self
+                .layout_text(UiFontKind::Sans, s, scale, bold, italic)
+                .glyph_offsets,
+            TextFontKind::UiSerif => self
+                .layout_text(UiFontKind::Serif, s, scale, bold, italic)
+                .glyph_offsets,
+        }
+    }
+
+    fn layout_text(
+        &self,
+        font_kind: UiFontKind,
+        s: &str,
+        scale: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> UiTextLayout {
+        if let Some(engine) = &self.layout_engine {
+            if let Some(layout) =
+                engine.layout(font_kind, s, self.font_size_px * scale, bold, italic)
+            {
+                return layout;
+            }
+        }
+
+        let advance = if self.ui_avg_advance > 0.0 {
+            self.ui_avg_advance * scale
+        } else {
+            self.cell_width * 0.75 * scale
+        };
+        let mut glyph_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(s.chars().count());
+        let mut x = 0.0;
+        for _ in s.chars() {
+            glyph_offsets.push(x);
+            x += advance;
+        }
+        UiTextLayout {
+            width: x,
+            line_height: self.font_size_px * scale,
+            glyph_offsets,
+        }
+    }
+}

+use std::cell::RefCell;
+use std::collections::HashMap;
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+pub enum UiFontKind {
+    Sans,
+    Serif,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiTextLayout {
+    pub width: f32,
+    pub line_height: f32,
+    pub glyph_offsets: Vec<f32>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiFontFamilies {
+    pub sans: String,
+    pub serif: String,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+struct LayoutKey {
+    font: UiFontKind,
+    text: String,
+    size_q4: u16,
+    bold: bool,
+    italic: bool,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+struct LayoutCache {
+    factory: windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: UiFontFamilies,
+    cache: HashMap<LayoutKey, UiTextLayout>,
+}
+
+pub struct UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    inner: RefCell<LayoutCache>,
+}
+
+impl UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    pub fn new(families: UiFontFamilies) -> windows::core::Result<Self> {
+        use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+            DWriteCreateFactory, DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED, IDWriteFactory,
+        };
+
+        let factory: IDWriteFactory = unsafe { DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED)? };
+        Ok(Self {
+            inner: RefCell::new(LayoutCache {
+                factory,
+                families,
+                cache: HashMap::new(),
+            }),
+        })
+    }
+
+    #[cfg(not(windows))]
+    pub fn new(_families: UiFontFamilies) -> Result<Self, ()> {
+        Ok(Self {})
+    }
+
+    pub fn layout(
+        &self,
+        font: UiFontKind,
+        text: &str,
+        font_size_px: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+        #[cfg(windows)]
+        {
+            let key = LayoutKey {
+                font,
+                text: text.to_string(),
+                size_q4: (font_size_px.max(0.0) * 4.0).round() as u16,
+                bold,
+                italic,
+            };
+            let mut inner = self.inner.borrow_mut();
+            if let Some(layout) = inner.cache.get(&key) {
+                return Some(layout.clone());
+            }
+            let layout = compute_layout(&inner.factory, &inner.families, &key)?;
+            inner.cache.insert(key, layout.clone());
+            Some(layout)
+        }
+        #[cfg(not(windows))]
+        {
+            let _ = (font, text, font_size_px, bold, italic);
+            None
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn compute_layout(
+    factory: &windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: &UiFontFamilies,
+    key: &LayoutKey,
+) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+    use windows::core::PCWSTR;
+    use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+        DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL,
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR, DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS,
+        DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS, DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP,
+    };
+
+    let family = match key.font {
+        UiFontKind::Sans => &families.sans,
+        UiFontKind::Serif => &families.serif,
+    };
+    let family_wide = wide(family);
+    let locale = wide("en-US");
+    let utf16: Vec<u16> = key.text.encode_utf16().collect();
+
+    let weight = if key.bold {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR
+    };
+    let style = if key.italic {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL
+    };
+    let font_size_px = key.size_q4 as f32 / 4.0;
+
+    let format = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextFormat(
+                PCWSTR(family_wide.as_ptr()),
+                None,
+                weight,
+                style,
+                DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL,
+                font_size_px,
+                PCWSTR(locale.as_ptr()),
+            )
+            .ok()?
+    };
+    let _ = unsafe { format.SetWordWrapping(DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP) };
+
+    let layout = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextLayout(&utf16, &format, 4096.0, 4096.0)
+            .ok()?
+    };
+
+    let mut metrics = DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS::default();
+    unsafe { layout.GetMetrics(&mut metrics).ok()? };
+
+    let mut glyph_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(key.text.chars().count());
+    let mut utf16_index = 0u32;
+    for ch in key.text.chars() {
+        let mut x = 0.0f32;
+        let mut y = 0.0f32;
+        let mut hit = DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS::default();
+        unsafe {
+            layout
+                .HitTestTextPosition(utf16_index, false, &mut x, &mut y, &mut hit)
+                .ok()?;
+        }
+        glyph_offsets.push(x);
+        utf16_index += ch.len_utf16() as u32;
+    }
+
+    Some(UiTextLayout {
+        width: metrics.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace.max(metrics.width),
+        line_height: metrics.height.max(font_size_px),
+        glyph_offsets,
+    })
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn wide(value: &str) -> Vec<u16> {
+    value.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect()
+}

+        Self::new_font(ch, font_size, bold, italic, 2)
+    }
+}

+## Iteration 80 ÔÇö DirectWrite UI Layout + Background-Aware Compositing
+
+**Goal**: Replace the remaining faux chrome-text path with a real Windows
+measurement/compositing path instead of spending another loop on spacing polish.
+
+**Changes made**:
+
+1. **DirectWrite UI layout cache** (`ui/text_layout.rs`, `ui/builder.rs`) ÔÇö
+   Added a cached DirectWrite text layout engine for sans and serif UI runs.
+   `UiTextRenderer` now asks that engine for widths and per-glyph x offsets,
+   replacing the old `ui_char_advances` / average-advance fallback path for
+   real UI text measurement and placement.
+
+2. **Real font roles and italics** (`ui/builder.rs`, `terminal_renderer.rs`,
+   `ui/right_panel.rs`) ÔÇö `TextCommand` now carries a real font role
+   (`terminal`, `ui sans`, `ui serif`) plus italic state. The renderer picks
+   the matching rasterizer, and the poem panel now renders through a real
+   serif italic face instead of synthetic skew.
+
+3. **Background-aware compositing** (`ui/builder.rs`, `terminal_renderer.rs`,
+   `main.rs`) ÔÇö Text commands now choose between flat-background subpixel
+   blending and mixed-background grayscale AA. Flat chrome surfaces (status
+   bar, sidebar, tabs, right panel chrome) can use ClearType-style subpixel
+   blending, while mixed surfaces such as the welcome hero and breadcrumb
+   explicitly opt into grayscale AA.
+
+4. **Screenshot helper improved for real shell capture**
+   (`scripts/take-screenshot-now.ps1`) ÔÇö Added `-WindowOnly`, which uses
+   `PrintWindow` to capture the godly-shell window directly when full-desktop
+   capture is contaminated by some other foreground app. This gives a
+   deterministic native artifact even though the full-frame diff flow still
+   needs size normalization.
+

+parity gates. The shell now has a real DirectWrite measurement path, a real
+italic face, and a real compositing decision per text run. The remaining hard
+blockers are still physical-pixel presentation, inner-shell retained layout,

+struct UiFontBundle {
+    family: String,
+    rasterizer: Box<dyn godly_terminal_surface::glyph_rasterizer::GlyphRasterizer>,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_font_bundle(candidates: &[&str], label: &str) -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    use godly_terminal_surface::directwrite_rasterizer::DirectWriteRasterizer;
+
+    for family in candidates {
+        let mut dw = DirectWriteRasterizer::new().ok()?;
+        if dw.load_system_font(family).is_ok() {
+            log::info!("[FONT] {label}: {family}");
+            return Some(UiFontBundle {
+                family: (*family).to_string(),
+                rasterizer: Box::new(dw),
+            });
+        }
+    }
+    log::warn!("[FONT] No {label} font available from candidates: {}", candidates.join(", "));
+    None
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_sans_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    create_ui_font_bundle(&["Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI"], "UI sans font")

+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_serif_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {

+use std::cell::RefCell;
+use std::collections::HashMap;
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+pub enum UiFontKind {
+    Sans,
+    Serif,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiTextLayout {
+    pub width: f32,
+    pub line_height: f32,
+    pub glyph_offsets: Vec<f32>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiFontFamilies {
+    pub sans: String,
+    pub serif: String,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+struct LayoutKey {
+    font: UiFontKind,
+    text: String,
+    size_q4: u16,
+    bold: bool,
+    italic: bool,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+struct LayoutCache {
+    factory: windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: UiFontFamilies,
+    cache: HashMap<LayoutKey, UiTextLayout>,
+}
+
+pub struct UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    inner: RefCell<LayoutCache>,
+}
+
+impl UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    pub fn new(families: UiFontFamilies) -> windows::core::Result<Self> {
+        use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+            DWriteCreateFactory, DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED, IDWriteFactory,
+        };
+
+        let factory: IDWriteFactory = unsafe { DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED)? };
+        Ok(Self {
+            inner: RefCell::new(LayoutCache {
+                factory,
+                families,
+                cache: HashMap::new(),
+            }),
+        })
+    }
+
+    #[cfg(not(windows))]
+    pub fn new(_families: UiFontFamilies) -> Result<Self, ()> {
+        Ok(Self {})
+    }
+
+    pub fn layout(
+        &self,
+        font: UiFontKind,
+        text: &str,
+        font_size_px: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+        #[cfg(windows)]
+        {
+            let key = LayoutKey {
+                font,
+                text: text.to_string(),
+                size_q4: (font_size_px.max(0.0) * 4.0).round() as u16,
+                bold,
+                italic,
+            };
+            let mut inner = self.inner.borrow_mut();
+            if let Some(layout) = inner.cache.get(&key) {
+                return Some(layout.clone());
+            }
+            let layout = compute_layout(&inner.factory, &inner.families, &key)?;
+            inner.cache.insert(key, layout.clone());
+            Some(layout)
+        }
+        #[cfg(not(windows))]
+        {
+            let _ = (font, text, font_size_px, bold, italic);
+            None
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn compute_layout(
+    factory: &windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: &UiFontFamilies,
+    key: &LayoutKey,
+) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+    use windows::core::PCWSTR;
+    use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+        DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL,
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR, DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS,
+        DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS, DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP,
+    };
+
+    let family = match key.font {
+        UiFontKind::Sans => &families.sans,
+        UiFontKind::Serif => &families.serif,
+    };
+    let family_wide = wide(family);
+    let locale = wide("en-US");
+    let utf16: Vec<u16> = key.text.encode_utf16().collect();
+
+    let weight = if key.bold {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR
+    };
+    let style = if key.italic {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL
+    };
+    let font_size_px = key.size_q4 as f32 / 4.0;
+
+    let format = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextFormat(
+                PCWSTR(family_wide.as_ptr()),
+                None,
+                weight,
+                style,
+                DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL,
+                font_size_px,
+                PCWSTR(locale.as_ptr()),
+            )
+            .ok()?
+    };
+    let _ = unsafe { format.SetWordWrapping(DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP) };
+
+    let layout = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextLayout(&utf16, &format, 4096.0, 4096.0)
+            .ok()?
+    };
+
+    let mut metrics = DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS::default();
+    unsafe { layout.GetMetrics(&mut metrics).ok()? };
+
+    let mut glyph_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(key.text.chars().count());
+    let mut utf16_index = 0u32;
+    for ch in key.text.chars() {
+        let mut x = 0.0f32;
+        let mut y = 0.0f32;
+        let mut hit = DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS::default();
+        unsafe {
+            layout
+                .HitTestTextPosition(utf16_index, false, &mut x, &mut y, &mut hit)
+                .ok()?;
+        }
+        glyph_offsets.push(x);
+        utf16_index += ch.len_utf16() as u32;
+    }
+
+    Some(UiTextLayout {
+        width: metrics.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace.max(metrics.width),
+        line_height: metrics.height.max(font_size_px),
+        glyph_offsets,
+    })
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn wide(value: &str) -> Vec<u16> {
+    value.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect()
+}

+            font_id,
+        }
+    }
+

+    pub fn new_ui(ch: char, font_size: f32, bold: bool) -> Self {
+        Self::new_font(ch, font_size, bold, false, 1)
+    }
+
+    pub fn new_ui_serif(ch: char, font_size: f32, bold: bool, italic: bool) -> Self {
+        Self::new_font(ch, font_size, bold, italic, 2)
+    }
+}

+
+**Goal**: Replace the remaining faux chrome-text path with a real Windows

+**Changes made**:
+
+1. **DirectWrite UI layout cache** (`ui/text_layout.rs`, `ui/builder.rs`) ÔÇö
+   Added a cached DirectWrite text layout engine for sans and serif UI runs.
+   `UiTextRenderer` now asks that engine for widths and per-glyph x offsets,
+   replacing the old `ui_char_advances` / average-advance fallback path for
+   real UI text measurement and placement.
+
+2. **Real font roles and italics** (`ui/builder.rs`, `terminal_renderer.rs`,
+   `ui/right_panel.rs`) ÔÇö `TextCommand` now carries a real font role
+   (`terminal`, `ui sans`, `ui serif`) plus italic state. The renderer picks

+   serif italic face instead of synthetic skew.

+   `main.rs`) ÔÇö Text commands now choose between flat-background subpixel

+struct UiFontBundle {
+    family: String,
+    rasterizer: Box<dyn godly_terminal_surface::glyph_rasterizer::GlyphRasterizer>,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_font_bundle(candidates: &[&str], label: &str) -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    use godly_terminal_surface::directwrite_rasterizer::DirectWriteRasterizer;
+
+    for family in candidates {
+        let mut dw = DirectWriteRasterizer::new().ok()?;
+        if dw.load_system_font(family).is_ok() {
+            log::info!("[FONT] {label}: {family}");
+            return Some(UiFontBundle {
+                family: (*family).to_string(),
+                rasterizer: Box::new(dw),
+            });
+        }
+    }

+use std::cell::RefCell;
+use std::collections::HashMap;
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+pub enum UiFontKind {
+    Sans,
+    Serif,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiTextLayout {
+    pub width: f32,
+    pub line_height: f32,
+    pub glyph_offsets: Vec<f32>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiFontFamilies {
+    pub sans: String,
+    pub serif: String,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+struct LayoutKey {
+    font: UiFontKind,
+    text: String,
+    size_q4: u16,
+    bold: bool,
+    italic: bool,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+struct LayoutCache {
+    factory: windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: UiFontFamilies,
+    cache: HashMap<LayoutKey, UiTextLayout>,
+}
+
+pub struct UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    inner: RefCell<LayoutCache>,
+}
+
+impl UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    pub fn new(families: UiFontFamilies) -> windows::core::Result<Self> {
+        use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+            DWriteCreateFactory, DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED, IDWriteFactory,
+        };
+
+        let factory: IDWriteFactory = unsafe { DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED)? };
+        Ok(Self {
+            inner: RefCell::new(LayoutCache {
+                factory,
+                families,
+                cache: HashMap::new(),
+            }),
+        })
+    }
+
+    #[cfg(not(windows))]
+    pub fn new(_families: UiFontFamilies) -> Result<Self, ()> {
+        Ok(Self {})
+    }
+
+    pub fn layout(
+        &self,
+        font: UiFontKind,
+        text: &str,
+        font_size_px: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+        #[cfg(windows)]
+        {
+            let key = LayoutKey {
+                font,
+                text: text.to_string(),
+                size_q4: (font_size_px.max(0.0) * 4.0).round() as u16,
+                bold,
+                italic,
+            };
+            let mut inner = self.inner.borrow_mut();
+            if let Some(layout) = inner.cache.get(&key) {
+                return Some(layout.clone());
+            }
+            let layout = compute_layout(&inner.factory, &inner.families, &key)?;
+            inner.cache.insert(key, layout.clone());
+            Some(layout)
+        }
+        #[cfg(not(windows))]
+        {
+            let _ = (font, text, font_size_px, bold, italic);
+            None
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn compute_layout(
+    factory: &windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: &UiFontFamilies,
+    key: &LayoutKey,
+) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+    use windows::core::PCWSTR;
+    use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+        DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL,
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR, DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS,
+        DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS, DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP,
+    };
+
+    let family = match key.font {
+        UiFontKind::Sans => &families.sans,
+        UiFontKind::Serif => &families.serif,
+    };
+    let family_wide = wide(family);
+    let locale = wide("en-US");
+    let utf16: Vec<u16> = key.text.encode_utf16().collect();
+
+    let weight = if key.bold {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR
+    };
+    let style = if key.italic {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL
+    };
+    let font_size_px = key.size_q4 as f32 / 4.0;
+
+    let format = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextFormat(
+                PCWSTR(family_wide.as_ptr()),
+                None,
+                weight,
+                style,
+                DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL,
+                font_size_px,
+                PCWSTR(locale.as_ptr()),
+            )
+            .ok()?
+    };
+    let _ = unsafe { format.SetWordWrapping(DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP) };
+
+    let layout = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextLayout(&utf16, &format, 4096.0, 4096.0)
+            .ok()?
+    };
+
+    let mut metrics = DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS::default();
+    unsafe { layout.GetMetrics(&mut metrics).ok()? };
+
+    let mut glyph_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(key.text.chars().count());
+    let mut utf16_index = 0u32;
+    for ch in key.text.chars() {
+        let mut x = 0.0f32;
+        let mut y = 0.0f32;
+        let mut hit = DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS::default();
+        unsafe {
+            layout
+                .HitTestTextPosition(utf16_index, false, &mut x, &mut y, &mut hit)
+                .ok()?;
+        }
+        glyph_offsets.push(x);
+        utf16_index += ch.len_utf16() as u32;
+    }
+
+    Some(UiTextLayout {
+        width: metrics.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace.max(metrics.width),
+        line_height: metrics.height.max(font_size_px),
+        glyph_offsets,
+    })
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn wide(value: &str) -> Vec<u16> {
+    value.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect()
+}

+            codepoint: ch,

+            italic,
+            font_id,
+        }
+    }
+

+    pub fn new_ui(ch: char, font_size: f32, bold: bool) -> Self {
+        Self::new_font(ch, font_size, bold, false, 1)
+    }
+
+    pub fn new_ui_serif(ch: char, font_size: f32, bold: bool, italic: bool) -> Self {
+        Self::new_font(ch, font_size, bold, italic, 2)
+    }
+}

+   Added a cached DirectWrite text layout engine for sans and serif UI runs.
+   `UiTextRenderer` now asks that engine for widths and per-glyph x offsets,
+   replacing the old `ui_char_advances` / average-advance fallback path for
+   real UI text measurement and placement.
+
+2. **Real font roles and italics** (`ui/builder.rs`, `terminal_renderer.rs`,
+   `ui/right_panel.rs`) ÔÇö `TextCommand` now carries a real font role
+   (`terminal`, `ui sans`, `ui serif`) plus italic state. The renderer picks
+   the matching rasterizer, and the poem panel now renders through a real
+   serif italic face instead of synthetic skew.
+
+3. **Background-aware compositing** (`ui/builder.rs`, `terminal_renderer.rs`,
+   `main.rs`) ÔÇö Text commands now choose between flat-background subpixel
+   blending and mixed-background grayscale AA. Flat chrome surfaces (status
+   bar, sidebar, tabs, right panel chrome) can use ClearType-style subpixel
+   blending, while mixed surfaces such as the welcome hero and breadcrumb
+   explicitly opt into grayscale AA.
+
+4. **Screenshot helper improved for real shell capture**
+   (`scripts/take-screenshot-now.ps1`) ÔÇö Added `-WindowOnly`, which uses
+   `PrintWindow` to capture the godly-shell window directly when full-desktop
+   capture is contaminated by some other foreground app. This gives a
+   deterministic native artifact even though the full-frame diff flow still
+   needs size normalization.
+

+

+
+**Result**: The text path is materially better aligned with the non-negotiable

+italic face, and a real compositing decision per text run. The remaining hard
+blockers are still physical-pixel presentation, inner-shell retained layout,

+struct UiFontBundle {
+    family: String,

+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_font_bundle(candidates: &[&str], label: &str) -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    use godly_terminal_surface::directwrite_rasterizer::DirectWriteRasterizer;
+
+    for family in candidates {
+        let mut dw = DirectWriteRasterizer::new().ok()?;
+        if dw.load_system_font(family).is_ok() {
+            log::info!("[FONT] {label}: {family}");
+            return Some(UiFontBundle {
+                family: (*family).to_string(),
+                rasterizer: Box::new(dw),
+            });
+        }
+    }
+    log::warn!("[FONT] No {label} font available from candidates: {}", candidates.join(", "));
+    None
+}
+

+        s: &str,
+        scale: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> f32 {

+
+    pub fn glyph_offsets_ui(
+        &self,
+        s: &str,
+        scale: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+        font_kind: TextFontKind,
+    ) -> Vec<f32> {
+        match font_kind {
+            TextFontKind::TerminalMono => Vec::new(),
+            TextFontKind::UiSans => self
+                .layout_text(UiFontKind::Sans, s, scale, bold, italic)
+                .glyph_offsets,
+            TextFontKind::UiSerif => self
+                .layout_text(UiFontKind::Serif, s, scale, bold, italic)
+                .glyph_offsets,
+        }
+    }
+
+    fn layout_text(
+        &self,
+        font_kind: UiFontKind,
+        s: &str,
+        scale: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> UiTextLayout {
+        if let Some(engine) = &self.layout_engine {
+            if let Some(layout) =
+                engine.layout(font_kind, s, self.font_size_px * scale, bold, italic)
+            {
+                return layout;
+            }
+        }
+
+        let advance = if self.ui_avg_advance > 0.0 {
+            self.ui_avg_advance * scale
+        } else {
+            self.cell_width * 0.75 * scale
+        };
+        let mut glyph_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(s.chars().count());
+        let mut x = 0.0;
+        for _ in s.chars() {
+            glyph_offsets.push(x);
+            x += advance;
+        }
+        UiTextLayout {
+            width: x,
+            line_height: self.font_size_px * scale,
+            glyph_offsets,
+        }
+    }
+}

+use std::cell::RefCell;
+use std::collections::HashMap;
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+pub enum UiFontKind {
+    Sans,
+    Serif,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiTextLayout {
+    pub width: f32,
+    pub line_height: f32,
+    pub glyph_offsets: Vec<f32>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct UiFontFamilies {
+    pub sans: String,
+    pub serif: String,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+struct LayoutKey {
+    font: UiFontKind,
+    text: String,
+    size_q4: u16,
+    bold: bool,
+    italic: bool,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+struct LayoutCache {
+    factory: windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: UiFontFamilies,
+    cache: HashMap<LayoutKey, UiTextLayout>,
+}
+
+pub struct UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    inner: RefCell<LayoutCache>,
+}
+
+impl UiTextLayoutEngine {
+    #[cfg(windows)]
+    pub fn new(families: UiFontFamilies) -> windows::core::Result<Self> {
+        use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+            DWriteCreateFactory, DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED, IDWriteFactory,
+        };
+
+        let factory: IDWriteFactory = unsafe { DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED)? };
+        Ok(Self {
+            inner: RefCell::new(LayoutCache {
+                factory,
+                families,
+                cache: HashMap::new(),
+            }),
+        })
+    }
+
+    #[cfg(not(windows))]
+    pub fn new(_families: UiFontFamilies) -> Result<Self, ()> {
+        Ok(Self {})
+    }
+
+    pub fn layout(
+        &self,
+        font: UiFontKind,
+        text: &str,
+        font_size_px: f32,
+        bold: bool,
+        italic: bool,
+    ) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+        #[cfg(windows)]
+        {
+            let key = LayoutKey {
+                font,
+                text: text.to_string(),
+                size_q4: (font_size_px.max(0.0) * 4.0).round() as u16,
+                bold,
+                italic,
+            };
+            let mut inner = self.inner.borrow_mut();
+            if let Some(layout) = inner.cache.get(&key) {
+                return Some(layout.clone());
+            }
+            let layout = compute_layout(&inner.factory, &inner.families, &key)?;
+            inner.cache.insert(key, layout.clone());
+            Some(layout)
+        }
+        #[cfg(not(windows))]
+        {
+            let _ = (font, text, font_size_px, bold, italic);
+            None
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn compute_layout(
+    factory: &windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::IDWriteFactory,
+    families: &UiFontFamilies,
+    key: &LayoutKey,
+) -> Option<UiTextLayout> {
+    use windows::core::PCWSTR;
+    use windows::Win32::Graphics::DirectWrite::{
+        DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL,
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR, DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS,
+        DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS, DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP,
+    };
+
+    let family = match key.font {
+        UiFontKind::Sans => &families.sans,
+        UiFontKind::Serif => &families.serif,
+    };
+    let family_wide = wide(family);
+    let locale = wide("en-US");
+    let utf16: Vec<u16> = key.text.encode_utf16().collect();
+
+    let weight = if key.bold {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_REGULAR
+    };
+    let style = if key.italic {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_ITALIC
+    } else {
+        DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL
+    };
+    let font_size_px = key.size_q4 as f32 / 4.0;
+
+    let format = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextFormat(
+                PCWSTR(family_wide.as_ptr()),
+                None,
+                weight,
+                style,
+                DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL,
+                font_size_px,
+                PCWSTR(locale.as_ptr()),
+            )
+            .ok()?
+    };
+    let _ = unsafe { format.SetWordWrapping(DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP) };
+
+    let layout = unsafe {
+        factory
+            .CreateTextLayout(&utf16, &format, 4096.0, 4096.0)
+            .ok()?
+    };
+
+    let mut metrics = DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS::default();
+    unsafe { layout.GetMetrics(&mut metrics).ok()? };
+
+    let mut glyph_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(key.text.chars().count());
+    let mut utf16_index = 0u32;
+    for ch in key.text.chars() {
+        let mut x = 0.0f32;
+        let mut y = 0.0f32;
+        let mut hit = DWRITE_HIT_TEST_METRICS::default();
+        unsafe {
+            layout
+                .HitTestTextPosition(utf16_index, false, &mut x, &mut y, &mut hit)
+                .ok()?;
+        }
+        glyph_offsets.push(x);
+        utf16_index += ch.len_utf16() as u32;
+    }
+
+    Some(UiTextLayout {
+        width: metrics.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace.max(metrics.width),
+        line_height: metrics.height.max(font_size_px),
+        glyph_offsets,
+    })
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn wide(value: &str) -> Vec<u16> {
+    value.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect()
+}

+struct UiFontBundle {
+    family: String,
+    rasterizer: Box<dyn godly_terminal_surface::glyph_rasterizer::GlyphRasterizer>,
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_font_bundle(candidates: &[&str], label: &str) -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    use godly_terminal_surface::directwrite_rasterizer::DirectWriteRasterizer;
+
+    for family in candidates {
+        let mut dw = DirectWriteRasterizer::new().ok()?;
+        if dw.load_system_font(family).is_ok() {
+            log::info!("[FONT] {label}: {family}");
+            return Some(UiFontBundle {
+                family: (*family).to_string(),
+                rasterizer: Box::new(dw),
+            });
+        }
+    }
+    log::warn!("[FONT] No {label} font available from candidates: {}", candidates.join(", "));
+    None
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_sans_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    create_ui_font_bundle(&["Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI"], "UI sans font")
+}
+
+#[cfg(windows)]
+fn create_ui_serif_font() -> Option<UiFontBundle> {
+    create_ui_font_bundle(&["Georgia", "Cambria", "Times New Roman"], "UI serif font")

+        if let Some(engine) = &self.layout_engine {

+        }
